en.s: The Battle of Blain, also called the Battle of Messac, was fought on 24 May 843 by the forces of Lambert II of Nantes and Erispoe, prince of Brittany, against Renaud, Frankish Count of Nantes. It arose from Breton resistance to Frankish power within Brittany and disputes over control of the County of Nantes. The defeat of the Franks led to a period of Breton expansionism.

zh.s: 布兰战役又称梅萨克战役，于843年5月24日爆发。南特的兰贝尔二世和布列塔尼王子埃里斯波率军，与法兰克的南特伯爵雷诺交战。战役源于布列塔尼人反抗法兰克势力，以及各方争夺南特伯国控制权。法兰克军队战败后，布列塔尼开始扩张势力。

en.s: The Sack of Damietta was a successful raid on the port city of Damietta on the Nile Delta by the Byzantine navy on 22–24 May 853. The city, whose garrison was absent at the time, was sacked and plundered, yielding not only many captives but also large quantities of weapons and supplies intended for the Arab Emirate of Crete.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 853年5月22日至24日，拜占庭海军成功袭击尼罗河三角洲港口城市达米埃塔。当地守军当时不在城内，拜占庭军队遂洗劫城市，掠走大批俘虏以及原本供克里特阿拉伯酋长国使用的大量武器和补给。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The ten-year-old Lambert Simnel is crowned in Christ Church Cathedral, Dublin, Ireland, with the name of Edward VI in a bid to threaten King Henry VII's reign
en.s: Lambert Simnel (c. 1477 – after 1534) was a pretender to the throne of England. In 1487, his claim to be Edward Plantagenet, 17th Earl of Warwick, threatened the newly established reign of Henry VII (1485-1509). Simnel became the figurehead of a Yorkist rebellion organised by John de la Pole, Earl of Lincoln. The rebellion was crushed in 1487.

zh.t: 10岁的兰伯特·西姆内尔在都柏林基督教堂大教堂加冕为爱德华六世，企图威胁亨利七世的统治
zh.s: 兰伯特·西姆内尔（约1477年—1534年后）是英格兰王位觊觎者。1487年，他自称是第十七代沃里克伯爵爱德华·金雀花，威胁到新建立的亨利七世统治（1485—1509年）。西姆内尔成为约翰·德·拉·波尔、林肯伯爵组织的约克派叛乱的傀儡人物。叛乱于1487年被镇压。

en.s: The Battle of Manila (1570) was fought in Manila between the native Filipinos led by Raja Soliman (III) and the Spaniards led by Martin de Goiti, Maestro de Campo on May 24, 1570. The forces under Goiti were victorious and as a result Manila became a capital of the Philippines. Miguel López de Legazpi was searching for a suitable place to establish the Spanish colonial capital after being forced to leave first Cebu and then Iloilo by Portuguese pirates. In 1570, Martin de Goiti and Captain Juan de Salcedo, with food stocks diminishing, discovered a sultanate on Luzon and saw its potential.

zh.s: 1570年5月24日，马尼拉发生战役，交战双方是拉贾·苏利曼三世率领的菲律宾本土军队和马丁·德·戈伊蒂·德·坎波率领的西班牙军队。戈伊蒂所部获胜，马尼拉因此成为菲律宾的首都。葡萄牙海盗先后迫使米格尔·洛佩斯·德·莱加斯皮离开宿务和伊洛伊洛，他于是寻找合适地点建立西班牙殖民地首府。1570年，马丁·德·戈伊蒂和胡安·德·萨尔塞多上尉粮食日渐短缺，他们发现吕宋岛上有一个苏丹国，并看到了该地的潜力。

en.s: The Fire of Moscow occurred on 24 May 1571, when a Crimean Army led by the khan of Crimea Devlet I Giray, together with its allied tribal contingents bypassed the Serpukhov defensive fortifications on the Oka River, crossed the Ugra River into the Moscow suburbs, and rounded the flank of the 36,000–40,000 men of the Russian army.

zh.s: 1571年5月24日，克里米亚汗国军队在汗王德夫莱特一世·格莱率领下，连同其盟友部族的部队，绕过奥卡河上的谢尔普霍夫防线，渡过乌格拉河进入莫斯科郊区，并从俄罗斯军队侧翼迂回。俄军兵力为3.6万至4万人。

en.s: The siege of Busanjin (Korean: 부산진 전투; Hanja: 釜山鎭戰鬪) was a battle fought at Busan on 24 May 1592, between Japanese and Korean forces. The attacks on Busan and the neighboring fort of Dadaejin were the first battles of the Japanese invasions of Korea (1592–98).

zh.s: 釜山镇之围（韩语：부산진 전투；汉字：釜山鎭戰鬪）是1592年5月24日日本与朝鲜军队在釜山交战的一场战役。日军进攻釜山及附近的多大镇，是日本侵略朝鲜（1592—1598年）的首批战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Craon took place during the Brittany campaign of the French Wars of Religion in Craon, Mayenne between 21–24 May 1592. It was fought between a French Crown army under Henri de Bourbon, Duke of Montpensier and François de Bourbon, Prince of Conti and a joint Catholic League and Spanish force; the French Crown troops were reinforced by a contingent of English soldiers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克朗战役于1592年5月21日至24日在马耶讷省克朗举行，属于法国宗教战争期间的布列塔尼战役。交战双方是亨利·德·波旁（蒙庞西耶公爵）和弗朗索瓦·德·波旁（孔蒂亲王）率领的法国王军，以及天主教同盟与西班牙联军；法国王军还得到一支英军增援。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Jamestown, the first permanent English colony in North America, is founded
en.s: The Jamestown settlement in the Colony of Virginia was the first permanent English settlement in the Americas. It was located, in what later became James City County, on the northeast bank of the James River, about 2.5 mi (4 km) southwest of present-day Williamsburg. It was established by the Virginia Company of London as "James Fort" on May 4, 1607 O.S. (May 14, 1607 N.S.).

zh.t: 詹姆斯敦建立，成为北美第一个永久性英国殖民地
zh.s: 弗吉尼亚殖民地的詹姆斯敦定居点是美洲第一个永久性英国定居点，位于后来成立的詹姆斯城郡境内、詹姆斯河东北岸，距今威廉斯堡西南约2.5英里（4公里）。伦敦弗吉尼亚公司于1607年旧历5月4日（新历5月14日）将其设立为“詹姆斯堡”。

en.s: The Sack of Magdeburg, also called the Magdeburg Wedding (German: Magdeburger Hochzeit) or Magdeburg's Sacrifice (Magdeburgs Opfergang), was the destruction of the Protestant city of Magdeburg on 20–24 May 1631 by the Imperial Army and the forces of the Catholic League, resulting in the deaths of around 20,000, including both defenders and civilians. This event is considered the worst massacre of the Thirty Years' War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马格德堡劫掠事件又称“马格德堡婚礼”（德语：Magdeburger Hochzeit）或“马格德堡的牺牲”（Magdeburgs Opfergang）。1631年5月20日至24日，帝国军和天主教同盟军摧毁新教城市马格德堡，约2万人死亡，其中包括守军和平民。这被视为三十年战争中最惨重的屠杀。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Rhunahaorine Moss was a battle between Covenanters led by General David Leslie and Royalist forces led by Alasdair Mac Colla Chiotaich (Sir Alexander MacDonald) at Rhunahaorine Point, Kintyre, Scotland on 24 May 1647. The Covenanters defeated the Royalists. Largie Castle at Rhunahaorine, home of the MacDonalds of Largie, was razed by the forces of General David Leslie.

zh.s: 1647年5月24日，鲁纳霍林角的鲁纳霍林沼泽发生战役。戴维·莱斯利将军率领的圣约派与阿拉斯代尔·麦克科拉·乔蒂赫（亚历山大·麦克唐纳爵士）率领的保王派交战。圣约派击败保王派。鲁纳霍林当地的麦克唐纳家族拉吉城堡被莱斯利将军的部队夷为平地。

en.s: The War of Devolution took place from May 1667 to May 1668. In the course of the war, France occupied large parts of the Spanish Netherlands and Franche-Comté, both then provinces of the Holy Roman Empire ruled by Spain. Its name derives from an obscure law known as the Jus Devolutionis, used by Louis XIV to claim that these territories had "devolved" to him by right of marriage to Maria Theresa of Spain.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 遗产战争从1667年5月持续到1668年5月。战争期间，法国占领了西属尼德兰和弗朗什-孔泰的大部分地区；当时这两地都是由西班牙统治的神圣罗马帝国领地。战争名称源于一项鲜为人知的法律“遗产法”（Jus Devolutionis）。路易十四借此主张，自己因与西班牙的玛丽亚·特蕾莎结婚，依法继承了这些领土。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: The Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, England, opens as the world's first university museum
en.s: The Ashmolean Museum of Art and Archaeology () on Beaumont Street in Oxford, England, is Britain's first public museum. Its first building was erected in 1678–1683 to house the cabinet of curiosities that Elias Ashmole gave to the University of Oxford in 1677. It is also the world's second university museum, after the establishment of the Kunstmuseum Basel in 1661 by the University of Basel.

zh.t: 英国牛津阿什莫林博物馆开放，成为世界上首座大学博物馆
zh.s: 阿什莫林艺术与考古博物馆位于英格兰牛津博蒙特街，是英国首座公共博物馆。首座馆舍于1678年至1683年建成，用于收藏伊莱亚斯·阿什莫尔于1677年赠予牛津大学的珍奇藏品。它也是世界上第二座大学博物馆；瑞士巴塞尔大学于1661年建立的巴塞尔艺术博物馆是第一座。

en.s: The action at La Hogue occurred during the pursuit by the English and Dutch of the French fleet after the Battle of Barfleur on 19 May Old Style (29 May (New Style)), 1692, during the Nine Years' War. The pursuing Anglo-Dutch fleet, under the command of Admiral of the Fleet Edward Russell, 1st Earl of Orford, destroyed 12 French ships of the line that had been beached near the port of Saint-Vaast-la-Hougue.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1692年拉霍格海战发生在九年战争期间，英荷舰队在巴夫勒尔海战后追击法国舰队时展开。奥福德伯爵、舰队司令爱德华·拉塞尔率领的英荷舰队，摧毁了停泊在圣瓦斯特拉乌格港附近海滩上的12艘法国战列舰。巴夫勒尔海战发生于旧历5月19日（新历5月29日）。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The action at Cherbourg was fought on 21 and 22 May Old Style (1st and 2 June New Style) 1692 as part of the aftermath of the action at Barfleur which had just been fought on 19 May (Old Style) 1692.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瑟堡海战于1692年旧历5月21日和22日（新历6月1日和2日）进行，是巴夫勒尔海战后续行动的一部分；巴夫勒尔海战刚于1692年旧历5月19日结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Sahay or Zahájí was fought on May 24, 1742 near village of Zahájí, about 15 km (10 mi) NW of Budweis (nowadays České Budějovice) in southern Bohemia, between the French under the Duc de Broglie and the Austrians under Lobkowitz. The battle was part of the War of the Austrian Succession and was conducted in cooperation with the Prussians under Frederick the Great who had defeated the Austrians a week previously at the battle of Chotusitz. Broglie won a small, but politically important, victory which combined with Frederick's success at Chotusitz disposed Maria Theresa to cede Silesia in the peace of Breslau on June 11, 1742.

zh.s: 扎海伊战役又称萨海战役，于1742年5月24日在南波希米亚扎海伊村附近爆发，该村位于今捷克布杰约维采西北约15公里（10英里）。交战双方是德布罗意公爵率领的法国军队和洛博科维茨率领的奥地利军队。战役是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分，并与腓特烈大帝率领的普鲁士军队协同进行；普鲁士一周前在霍图西茨战役中击败奥地利。德布罗意取得了规模不大但具有政治意义的胜利。加上腓特烈在霍图西茨的胜利，这使玛丽亚·特蕾莎愿意在1742年6月11日签订的布雷斯劳和约中割让西里西亚。

en.s: The Meigs Raid (also known as the Battle of Sag Harbor) was a military raid by American Continental Army forces, under the command of Connecticut Colonel Return Jonathan Meigs, on a British Loyalist foraging party at Sag Harbor, New York on May 24, 1777, during the American Revolutionary War. Six Loyalists were killed and 90 captured while the Americans suffered no casualties.

zh.s: 米格斯突袭又称萨格港战役，是美国大陆军在美国独立战争期间发动的一次军事突袭。1777年5月24日，康涅狄格州上校雷图恩·乔纳森·米格斯率部，在纽约州萨格港袭击一支为英军搜集补给的效忠派队伍。6名效忠派人员死亡、90人被俘；美军无人伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Erquelinnes or Battle of Péchant (24 May 1794) was part of the Flanders Campaign during the War of the First Coalition, and saw a Republican French army jointly led by Jacques Desjardin and Louis Charbonnier try to defend a bridgehead on the north bank of the Sambre River against a combined Habsburg Austrian and Dutch army led by Franz Wenzel, Graf von Kaunitz-Rietberg.

zh.s: 埃尔克利讷战役又称佩尚战役，发生于1794年5月24日，是第一次反法同盟战争中佛兰德战役的一部分。雅克·德雅尔丹和路易·沙博尼耶共同率领的法国共和军，试图守住桑布尔河北岸的一处桥头堡，抵挡弗朗茨·文策尔·冯·考尼茨-里特贝格伯爵率领的哈布斯堡奥地利和荷兰联军。

loc: 爱尔兰基尔代尔郡繁荣镇

en.s: The Battle of Prosperous is the name given to a military engagement between the forces of the British Crown and the United Irishmen during the 1798 rebellion. Prosperous, County Kildare, a recently founded (1780) cotton-manufacturing town, was attacked shortly after the outbreak of the 1798 rebellion at 2 a.m on 24 May 1798 by a rebel force about 60 strong which targeted the British garrison consisting of Cork militia and a detachment of a Welsh regiment, the "Ancient Britons". The rebel entry into the town was preceded by the infiltration of a small vanguard who, possibly aided by female sympathisers within, scaled the walls of the militia barracks, killed the sentries and opened the gate.

zh.s: 繁荣镇战役是1798年爱尔兰起义期间，英国王室军队与联合爱尔兰人之间一次交战的名称。1798年5月24日凌晨2时左右，约60名叛军袭击基尔代尔郡繁荣镇。该镇创立于1780年，主要发展棉纺织业。袭击目标是由科克民兵和威尔士军团“古不列颠人”分队驻守的英国军营。叛军进入城镇前，一支小规模先头部队可能得到当地女性支持者协助，翻过民兵军营围墙，杀死哨兵并打开大门。

en.s: The Battle of Naas took place in Ireland on 24 May 1798.

zh.s: 1798年5月24日，爱尔兰纳斯发生战役。

en.s: The Battle of Kilcullen took place on 24 May 1798 near the two settlements of that name in County Kildare, and was one of the first engagements in the Irish Rebellion of 1798 consisting of two separate clashes between a force of United Irish rebels and government forces.

zh.s: 基尔库伦战役于1798年5月24日在爱尔兰基尔代尔郡的两个同名聚落附近爆发，是1798年爱尔兰起义初期的战斗之一。战斗分为两次交锋，交战双方是联合爱尔兰人起义军和政府军。

en.s: The Battle of Ballymore-Eustace was one of the events in the United Irish rebellion of 1798. It took place on 24 May 1798 after the stationing of the 9th Dragoons, and members of the Tyrone, Antrim and Armagh Militias at Ballymore in County Kildare near the Kildare-Wicklow border on 10 May. The town had been recently garrisoned by almost 200 soldiers and militia who had been sent to repress sedition in the area.

zh.t: 巴利莫尔-尤斯塔斯战役
zh.s: 巴利莫尔-尤斯塔斯战役是1798年联合爱尔兰人起义期间的一次战斗。1798年5月10日，第9龙骑兵团以及蒂龙、安特里姆和阿马民兵部队进驻基尔代尔郡巴利莫尔镇；当地驻扎着近200名士兵和民兵，负责镇压该地区的叛乱活动。战役于5月24日爆发。

en.s: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 (Irish: Éirí Amach 1798; Ulster Scots: "The Turn Out"/"The Hurries") was a popular insurrection against the British Crown in what was then the separate, but subordinate, Kingdom of Ireland. The main organising force was the Society of United Irishmen. First formed in Belfast by Presbyterians opposed to the landed Anglican establishment, the Society, despairing of reform, sought to secure a republic through a revolutionary union with the country's Catholic majority.
en.n: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 led by the United Irishmen against British rule begins.

zh.s: 1798年爱尔兰起义（爱尔兰语：Éirí Amach 1798；阿尔斯特苏格兰语：“The Turn Out”／“The Hurries”）是爱尔兰王国民众反抗英国王室的起义。当时的爱尔兰王国名义上独立，但受英国支配。主要组织者是联合爱尔兰人协会。该协会最初由贝尔法斯特一群长老会信徒创立，他们反对土地由圣公会精英掌控。由于改革无望，协会转而寻求与爱尔兰占多数的天主教徒联合发动革命，建立共和国。
zh.n: 联合爱尔兰人领导的1798年爱尔兰起义于这一天开始，反对英国统治。

en.s: The siege of Danzig (19 March – 24 May 1807) was the French encirclement and capture of Danzig during the War of the Fourth Coalition. On 19 March 1807, around 27,000 French troops under Marshal Lefebvre besieged around 14,400 Prussian troops under Marshal Kalckreuth garrisoning the city of Danzig.

zh.s: 1807年3月19日至5月24日，但泽围城战中，法军包围并攻占但泽。这场围城战发生在第四次反法同盟战争期间。1807年3月19日，勒费弗尔元帅率领约27,000名法军开始围城；但泽城内由卡尔克罗伊特元帅率领约14,400名普军驻守。

en.s: The Battle of the Sink Hole was fought on May 24, 1815, after the official end of the War of 1812, between Missouri Rangers and Sauk Indians led by Black Hawk. The Sauk were unaware, or did not care, that their British patrons had signed the Treaty of Ghent with the U.S. The battle was fought in a low spot near the mouth of the Cuivre River in Missouri (present day City of Old Monroe), near Fort Howard and Fort Cap au Gris. An ambush by Sauk on a company of rangers led to a prolonged siege in which seven Rangers (including their commander, Cpt.

zh.s: 沉洞之战发生于 1815 年 5 月 24 日，即 1812 年战争正式结束后，交战双方是密苏里游骑兵与黑鹰率领的索克人。索克人并不知道，或并不在意，他们的英国盟友已与美国签署《根特条约》。战斗发生在密苏里州夸伊夫尔河口附近的一处低洼地带，也就是今天的密苏里州老门罗市附近，靠近霍华德堡和格里斯角堡。索克人伏击一支游骑兵连，战斗演变为持久围攻：七名游骑兵（包括指挥官彼得·克雷格上尉）和一名索克人阵亡，另有三名游骑兵受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Valtetsi was fought on 24 May 1821 in Valtetsi between the Ottoman army and Greek revolutionaries.

en.s: The Battle of Pichincha took place on 24 May 1822, on the slopes of the Pichincha volcano, 3,500 meters above sea-level, right next to the city of Quito, in modern Ecuador. The encounter, fought in the context of the Spanish American wars of independence, pitted a Patriot army under General Antonio José de Sucre against a Royalist army commanded by Field Marshal Melchor Aymerich.

zh.s: 皮钦查战役于1822年5月24日在皮钦查火山山坡上爆发，海拔约3500米，紧邻今厄瓜多尔基多市。战斗发生在西属美洲独立战争期间，交战双方分别是安东尼奥·何塞·苏克雷将军率领的爱国军和梅尔乔尔·艾梅里奇元帅指挥的保王军。

en.s: The St. Vrain massacre was an incident in the Black Hawk War. It occurred near present-day Pearl City, Illinois, in Kellogg's Grove, on May 24, 1832. The massacre was most likely committed by Ho-Chunk warriors who were unaffiliated with Black Hawk's band of warriors. It is also unlikely that the group of Ho-Chunk had the sanction of their nation. Killed in the massacre were United States Indian Agent Felix St. Vrain and three of his companions. Some accounts reported that St. Vrain's body was mutilated. St. Vrain and his party were attacked while en route from Dixon's Ferry, Illinois (now Dixon) to Galena, Illinois.

zh.s: 圣弗兰大屠杀是黑鹰战争期间的一起事件，于1832年5月24日在美国伊利诺伊州凯洛格树林、今珍珠城附近发生。大屠杀很可能是由与黑鹰部队无关的霍-丘克族战士所为，也不太可能得到该部族的批准。遇害者包括美国印第安事务代理人菲利克斯·圣弗兰及其三名同伴。有些记载称，圣弗兰的尸体遭到肢解。他们在从伊利诺伊州迪克森渡口（今迪克森）前往加利纳途中遭到袭击。

en.s: The Battle of Huesca was fought during the First Carlist War on May 24, 1837, between Spanish Constitutionalists and Carlists. During the course of the battle, the French Foreign Legion, which had been attached to the Cristinist army, suffered heavy casualties resulting in its strength being halved. The result of the battle was a decisive Carlist victory.

zh.s: 韦斯卡战役于1837年5月24日第一次卡洛斯战争期间爆发，交战双方是西班牙立宪派和卡洛斯派。战斗中，隶属克里斯蒂娜派军队的法国外国兵团伤亡惨重，兵力减半。卡洛斯派取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Village Creek occurred on May 24, 1841, on the embankments of Village Creek. The battle, which evolved into a running gunfight between the Republic of Texas militia and the Village Creek tribes, was attributed to the increased Indian raids on Anglo settlements in the Red River counties.

zh.s: 村溪战役于1841年5月24日在村溪堤岸爆发。这场战斗演变为德克萨斯共和国民兵与村溪部落之间的流动枪战，原因是红河各县对盎格鲁人定居点的印第安人袭击增加。

en.t: Samuel Morse sends the message "What hath God wrought" (a biblical quotation, Numbers 23:23) from a committee room in the United States Capitol to his assistant, Alfred Vail, in Baltimore, Maryland, to inaugurate a commercial telegraph line between Baltimore and Washington D.C
en.s: Samuel Finley Breese Morse (April 27, 1791 – April 2, 1872) was an American inventor and painter. After establishing his reputation as a portrait painter, Morse, in his middle age, contributed to the invention of a single-wire telegraph system based on European telegraphs. He was a co-developer and the namesake of Morse code in 1837 and helped to develop the commercial use of telegraphy.

zh.t: 塞缪尔·莫尔斯从美国国会大厦向巴尔的摩助理阿尔弗雷德·韦尔发送“上帝成就了何等大事”，开启巴尔的摩至华盛顿特区的商业电报线路
zh.s: 塞缪尔·芬利·布里斯·莫尔斯（1791年4月27日—1872年4月2日）是美国发明家和画家。莫尔斯先以肖像画家闻名，中年时转而参与发明单线电报系统，该系统借鉴了欧洲的电报技术。他于1837年共同开发了摩尔斯电码，电码也以他的名字命名；他还推动了电报的商业应用。

en.s: The Pottawatomie massacre occurred on the night of May 24–25, 1856, in the Kansas Territory, United States. In reaction to the sacking of Lawrence by pro-slavery forces on May 21, and the telegraphed news of the severe attack on Massachusetts Senator Charles Sumner, John Brown and a band of abolitionist settlers—some of them members of the Pottawatomie Rifles—responded violently.

zh.s: 波塔瓦托米大屠杀发生于1856年5月24日至25日晚，地点在美国堪萨斯领地。5月21日，支持奴隶制的势力洗劫劳伦斯；随后有电报传来，称马萨诸塞州参议员查尔斯·萨姆纳遭到严重袭击。对此，约翰·布朗和一群废奴定居者作出暴力回应，其中一些人是波塔瓦托米步枪队成员。

en.t: American Civil War: Union troops occupy Alexandria, Virginia, with Colonel Elmer E. Ellsworth becoming the first Union officer to be killed during the war
en.s: Alexandria is an independent city in the U.S. state of Virginia. It lies on the western (or southern) bank of the Potomac River in Northern Virginia, bordering Washington, D.C. to the northeast. The city's population of 159,467 at the 2020 census made it the sixth-most populous city in Virginia and 169th-most populous city in the U.S.

zh.t: 美国内战：联邦军占领弗吉尼亚州亚历山德里亚，埃尔默·E·埃尔斯沃思上校成为战争中首位阵亡的联邦军军官
zh.s: 亚历山德里亚是美国弗吉尼亚州的独立市，位于波托马克河西岸（或南岸）的北弗吉尼亚地区，东北与华盛顿哥伦比亚特区接壤。根据2020年人口普查，该市有159,467人，是弗吉尼亚州人口第六多的城市，也是美国人口第169多的城市。

en.s: The Battle of Wilson's Wharf (also called the Battle of Fort Pocahontas) was a battle in Union Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign against Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia. On May 24, Confederate Maj. Gen. Fitzhugh Lee's cavalry division (about 2,500 men) attacked the Union supply depot at Wilson's Wharf, on the James River in eastern Charles City, Virginia.

zh.s: 威尔逊码头战役又称波卡洪塔斯堡战役，是美国内战期间的一场战斗，属于联邦军中将尤利西斯·格兰特对阵邦联军罗伯特·E·李将军北弗吉尼亚军团的陆上战役。5月24日，邦联军菲茨休·李少将率领约2500名骑兵，袭击了位于詹姆斯河畔、弗吉尼亚州查尔斯城县东部的威尔逊码头联邦军补给站。

en.s: The Battle of Tuyutí (Tuiuti in Portuguese) was a Paraguayan offensive in the Paraguayan War targeting the Triple Alliance encampment of Tuyutí. It is considered to be the bloodiest battle ever in South America. The result of the battle was an Allied victory, which added to the Paraguayan troubles after the loss of its fleet in the Battle of Riachuelo.

zh.s: 图尤蒂战役是巴拉圭战争期间巴拉圭军队发起的一次进攻，目标是三国同盟在图尤蒂的营地。它被认为是南美洲历史上伤亡最惨重的战役。战役以盟军获胜告终；此前巴拉圭舰队在里亚丘埃洛海战中失利，这场败仗又使巴拉圭处境更加艰难。

en.s: The siege of Khujand (17–24 May 1866) was part of an unapproved Russian military operation during the Russian conquest of Bukhara and Russo-Kokand War. The operation was led by Military Governor Dmitry Romanovsky and aimed to capture several settlements on the Russo-Bukharan border including Khujand. Khujand was a historically autonomous city, and had asserted independence from the Emirate of Bukhara several months before the siege.

zh.s: 1866年5月17日至24日的苦盏围城战，是俄罗斯征服布哈拉及俄国—浩罕战争期间一次未经授权的俄军行动的一部分。行动由军事总督德米特里·罗曼诺夫斯基率领，目标是攻占俄国与布哈拉边境的数个聚落，其中包括苦盏。苦盏历史上一直享有自治地位，并在围城前几个月宣布脱离布哈拉埃米尔国独立。

en.t: Patrick Francis Healy becomes the first black president of a predominantly white university in the United States
en.s: Patrick Francis Healy (February 27, 1834 – January 10, 1910) was an American Catholic priest and Jesuit who was an influential president of Georgetown University, becoming known as its "second founder". The university's flagship building, Healy Hall, bears his name. Though he considered himself and was widely accepted as White, Healy was posthumously recognized as the first Black American to earn a PhD, as well as the first to enter the Jesuit order and to become the president of a predominantly White university.

zh.t: 帕特里克·弗朗西斯·希利成为美国以白人为主的大学首位黑人校长
zh.s: 帕特里克·弗朗西斯·希利（1834年2月27日—1910年1月10日）是美国天主教神父和耶稣会士，曾任乔治城大学校长并颇具影响力，因此被称为该校的“第二位创始人”。学校的标志性建筑希利楼以他命名。他自认是白人，生前也普遍被视为白人；死后，他被追认为首位获得博士学位的非裔美国人、首位加入耶稣会的非裔美国人，也是美国首位担任以白人为主的大学校长的非裔美国人。

en.t: The Brooklyn Bridge in New York City is opened to traffic after 14 years of construction
en.s: The Brooklyn Bridge is a cable-stayed suspension bridge in New York City, spanning the East River between the boroughs of Manhattan and Brooklyn. Opened on May 24, 1883, the Brooklyn Bridge was the first fixed crossing of the East River. It was also the longest suspension bridge in the world when opened, with a main span of 1,595.5 feet (486.3 m) and a deck 127 ft (38.7 m) above mean high water.

zh.s: 布鲁克林大桥是纽约市一座斜拉悬索桥，横跨东河，连接曼哈顿和布鲁克林区。大桥于1883年5月24日开放通车，是首座横跨东河的固定式桥梁。通车时，它是世界上最长的悬索桥，主跨长1595.5英尺（486.3米），桥面高于平均高潮位127英尺（38.7米）。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 24 May 1908. Although the Catholic Party lost their absolute majority in Parliament, they remained the governing party, with François Schollaert retaining the post of Prime Minister. Both the Liberal Party and the Belgian Labour Party gained seats. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in four out of the nine provinces: Hainaut, Limburg, Liège and East Flanders.

zh.s: 1908年5月24日，比利时举行部分大选。天主教党失去议会绝对多数，但仍继续执政，弗朗索瓦·肖莱尔留任总理。自由党和比利时工党都增加了议席。按照轮替制度，选举只在九个省中的四个省举行：埃诺、林堡、列日和东佛兰德。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 24 May 1914.The result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 41 of the 88 seats up for election in the Chamber of Representatives. The Catholics had formed the government continuously since 1884; the incumbent de Broqueville government was in office since 1911. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in four out of the nine provinces: Hainaut, Limburg, Liège and East Flanders. This was the last time this system was applied, as the next elections in 1919 saw the introduction of full four-year terms.

zh.s: 1914年5月24日，比利时举行部分大选。天主教党获胜，在众议院改选的88个席位中赢得41席。天主教党自1884年以来一直执政，德布罗克维尔政府则自1911年起执政。按照轮替制度，选举只在九个省中的四个省举行：埃诺、林堡、列日和东佛兰德。这是最后一次实行轮替选举制度；1919年下一次选举开始采用完整的四年任期。

en.s: The raid on Porto Buso was an assault launched by the Italian Royal Navy on an Austro-Hungarian naval station and border post located in Porto Buso island, in the Marano-Grado Lagoon, in the first hours of 24 May 1915, the day when the Kingdom of Italy entered World War I on the side of the Entente.
en.n: The raid took place at Porto Buso in the Marano-Grado Lagoon, in present-day Italy.

zh.s: 1915年5月24日凌晨，意大利皇家海军袭击了位于马拉诺—格拉多潟湖布索港岛上的奥匈帝国海军哨站和边境据点。当天，意大利加入协约国阵营，正式参加第一次世界大战。
zh.n: 袭击地点是马拉诺—格拉多潟湖中的布索港，位于今天的意大利。

en.s: The Bombardment of Ancona was a naval engagement of the Adriatic Campaign of World War I between the navies of Italy and Austria-Hungary. Forces of the Imperial and Royal Navy attacked and bombarded military and civilian targets all across Ancona in central Italy and several other nearby islands and communities in response to Italy's declaration of war on Austria-Hungary.

zh.s: 安科纳炮击是第一次世界大战亚得里亚海战役中的一场海战，交战双方是意大利和奥匈帝国的海军。为回应意大利对奥匈帝国宣战，奥匈帝国海军袭击并炮击了意大利中部安科纳及附近多个岛屿和社区的军用与民用目标。

en.s: The White War (Italian: Guerra Bianca, German: Gebirgskrieg, Hungarian: Fehér Háború) is the name given to the fighting in the high-altitude Alpine sector of the Italian front during the First World War, principally in the Dolomites, the Ortles-Cevedale Alps and the Adamello-Presanella Alps. More than two-thirds of this conflict zone lies at an altitude above 2,000 m (6,600 ft)), rising to 3,905 m (12,812 ft) at Mount Ortler.

en.s: The Battle of Monte Piana was a long and bloody series of clashes that took place on the summit of Monte Piana which is part of the Sexten Dolomites massif. Between 1915 and 1917 some of the most violent clashes took place between Italian and Austro-Hungarian soldiers who fought for two years on the flat top of this mountain.

zh.s: 蒙特皮亚纳战役是在塞克斯滕多洛米蒂山脉的蒙特皮亚纳峰顶进行的一系列漫长而惨烈的交战。1915年至1917年间，意大利与奥匈帝国士兵在这座山的平顶上激烈交战，持续两年，其中一些战斗尤为惨烈。

zh.s: 哈姆德战役（阿拉伯语：معركة حمض）中，伊赫万战士约2000人，科威特骑兵100人，另有科威特步兵200人参战。战斗持续六天，双方伤亡惨重，具体数字不详。这场战斗促成了1920年10月的贾赫拉战役。

en.s: The Northern Ireland general election, 1921 was held on 24 May 1921. It was the first election to the Parliament of Northern Ireland. Ulster Unionist Party members won a two-thirds majority of votes cast and more than three-quarter of the seats in the assembly. Sinn Féin in particular was shocked at the scale of the Unionist victory, having spent considerable resources on the campaign, and had expected to win between 1/3 and 1/2 of the seats. The election was conducted using the single transferable vote system. The election took place during the Irish War of Independence, on the same day as the election to the parliament of Southern Ireland.

zh.s: 1921年5月24日，北爱尔兰举行大选，这是北爱尔兰议会成立后的首次选举。阿尔斯特统一党赢得三分之二的选票和超过四分之三的议席。新芬党尤其震惊于统一派的大胜；该党投入大量竞选资源，原本预计能赢得三分之一至二分之一的席位。选举采用单记可转让投票制，与爱尔兰独立战争期间南爱尔兰议会选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 1921 Northern Ireland and Southern Ireland general elections
en.s: General elections took place in Ireland in May 1921 to elect members of the House of Commons of Northern Ireland and the House of Commons of Southern Ireland. These legislatures had been established by the Government of Ireland Act 1920, which granted Home Rule to a partitioned Ireland within the United Kingdom. Polling day was 24 May and nomination day was 13 May.

zh.t: 1921年北爱尔兰和南爱尔兰大选
zh.s: 1921年5月，爱尔兰举行大选，选出北爱尔兰下议院和南爱尔兰下议院的议员。这两个议会依据《1920年爱尔兰政府法》设立；该法在爱尔兰分治、但仍属英国的一部分的框架下授予爱尔兰自治权。投票日为5月24日，候选人提名日为5月13日。

en.t: Guerrilla phase of the Irish Civil War
en.s: The guerrilla phase of the Irish Civil War began in August 1922, when the forces of the Irish Free State took all the fixed positions previously held by the Anti-Treaty IRA. The IRA then waged a guerrilla war to try to bring down the new Irish Government and overturn the Anglo-Irish Treaty. This guerrilla campaign was ultimately defeated.

zh.t: 爱尔兰内战的游击战阶段
zh.s: 爱尔兰内战的游击战阶段始于1922年8月。当时，爱尔兰自由邦军队控制了反条约派爱尔兰共和军此前占据的所有固定据点。随后，共和军转而发动游击战，试图推翻新成立的爱尔兰政府并废除《英爱条约》。这场游击战最终以失败告终。

en.s: The 1934 Czechoslovak presidential election took place on 24 May 1934. Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk was elected for his fourth term.

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 24 May 1936.The result was a victory for the Belgian Labour Party, which won 70 of the 202 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 39 of the 101 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 94.7%. Despite the rise of far-right and far-left parties, Paul van Zeeland continued as Prime Minister leading a government of national unity, composed of the three major parties (Catholics, Socialists and Liberals).

zh.s: 1936年5月24日，比利时举行大选。比利时工党获胜，在众议院202席中赢得70席，在参议院101席中赢得39席。投票率为94.7%。尽管极左和极右政党势力上升，保罗·范泽兰仍担任总理，领导由天主教徒、社会主义者和自由派三大党组成的民族团结政府。

en.s: The Battle of Suixian–Zaoyang (simplified Chinese: 随枣会战; traditional Chinese: 隨棗會戰; pinyin: Suízǎo Huìzhàn), also known as the Battle of Suizao, was one of the 22 major engagements between the National Revolutionary Army (NRA) and Imperial Japanese Army (IJA) during the Second Sino-Japanese War. The Japanese launched a major two-pronged offensive that captured many cities and towns.

en.s: Operation David was the code name for the advance of the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) into Belgium at the start of the Battle of Belgium during the Second World War. On the same day as the German invasion of neutral Belgium, 10 May 1940, the BEF moved forward from their defences on the Franco-Belgian border to take up a new position deep inside Belgium, conforming to French war planning 1920–1940, by Grand Quartier Général, the French high command.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 大卫行动是第二次世界大战比利时战役初期，英国远征军向比利时推进的代号。1940年5月10日德国入侵中立国比利时当天，英国远征军从法比边境防线向前推进，在比利时境内纵深处建立新阵地，以配合法国最高统帅部1920年至1940年的作战计划。

en.s: The Battle of the Denmark Strait was a naval engagement in the Second World War, which took place on 24 May 1941 between ships of the Royal Navy and the Kriegsmarine. The British battleship HMS Prince of Wales and the battlecruiser HMS Hood fought the German battleship Bismarck and the heavy cruiser Prinz Eugen, which were attempting to break out into the North Atlantic to attack Allied merchant shipping (Operation Rheinübung) through the Denmark Strait between Greenland and Iceland.

zh.s: 丹麦海峡海战是第二次世界大战期间的一场海战，于1941年5月24日在英国皇家海军与德国海军舰艇之间爆发。英国战列舰威尔士亲王号和战列巡洋舰胡德号与德国战列舰俾斯麦号、重巡洋舰欧根亲王号交战。德国舰艇正试图经由格陵兰岛和冰岛之间的丹麦海峡驶入北大西洋，执行“莱茵演习”行动，袭击盟军商船。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Boothby on 24 May 1941. This was triggered by the death of United Australia Party (UAP) MP John Price. The by-election was won by UAP candidate Grenfell Price, who was not related to his predecessor.

zh.s: 1941年5月24日，澳大利亚众议院布思比选区举行补选。时任联合澳大利亚党议员约翰·普赖斯去世，引发了这次补选。联合澳大利亚党候选人格伦费尔·普赖斯当选；他与前任议员没有亲属关系。

en.s: Black May refers to May 1943 in the Battle of the Atlantic campaign during World War II, when the Kriegsmarine U-boat arm (U-Bootwaffe) suffered high casualties with fewer Allied ships sunk; it is considered a watershed in the Battle of the Atlantic.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “黑色五月”指第二次世界大战大西洋战役中的1943年5月。当月德国海军潜艇部队（U-Bootwaffe）损失惨重，而盟军舰船被击沉的数量减少。这被视为大西洋战役的转折点。

en.s: The Congress of Përmet, was a meeting of the Albanian communist leaders in May 24, 1944, in Përmet, Albania, which elected a Provisional Government. The congress was modeled after the Anti-Fascist Council for the National Liberation of Yugoslavia.

zh.s: 1944年5月24日，阿尔巴尼亚共产党领导人在阿尔巴尼亚佩尔梅特举行会议，选出临时政府。会议仿照南斯拉夫反法西斯民族解放委员会的形式召开。

en.s: Börse Berlin AG, also known as the Berlin Stock Exchange, is a stock exchange based in Berlin, Germany, in the Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf borough. Founded in 1685 by an edict of Elector Friedrich Wilhelm, it is one of the oldest stock exchanges in Germany.

zh.t: 柏林证券交易所大楼在二战空袭中被击中后焚毁
zh.s: 柏林证券交易所股份公司（又称柏林证券交易所）位于德国柏林夏洛滕堡-威尔默斯多夫区。它由选帝侯腓特烈·威廉于1685年颁布敕令创立，是德国历史最悠久的证券交易所之一。

en.t: Arab–Israeli War: After five days of fighting, Egyptian forces captured the Israeli community of Yad Mordechai after the defenders had abandoned it
en.s: The Battle of Yad Mordechai was fought between Egypt and Israel in the 1948 Arab-Israeli War, at the Israeli kibbutz of Yad Mordechai. The Egyptians attacked the settlement several times throughout May 19 and May 20, but failed to capture it. A final attack was launched on May 23, in which the Egyptians succeeded in capturing part of Yad Mordechai, following which the Israeli defenders withdrew.

zh.s: 雅德莫迪凯战役发生在1948年阿以战争期间，交战双方是埃及和以色列，地点在以色列基布兹雅德莫迪凯。埃及军队在5月19日和20日多次进攻，但未能攻占该地。5月23日，埃及军队发动最后一次进攻，攻占基布兹部分地区，随后以色列守军撤出。

en.s: The Nicosia cinema bombing took place on 24 May 1955. A cinema in Nicosia was bombed by the EOKA as part of an unsuccessful attempt to assassinate British governor Sir Robert Armitage. The bomb went off a few yards from where Armitage had been sitting a few minutes earlier; however by the time of the explosion most of the cinema had been vacated.

zh.t: 尼科西亚电影院爆炸案
zh.s: 1955年5月24日，尼科西亚一家电影院遭到爆炸袭击。塞浦路斯战士民族组织（EOKA）企图借此刺杀英国总督罗伯特·阿米蒂奇，但未成功。炸弹在阿米蒂奇几分钟前坐过的位置附近爆炸；爆炸发生时，影院里大部分人已经离开。

en.t: The first edition of the Eurovision Song Contest was held in Lugano, Switzerland
en.s: The Eurovision Song Contest (ESC for short; French: Concours Eurovision de la chanson), often known simply as Eurovision, is an international song competition organised annually by the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) since 1956. Each participating broadcaster submits an original song representing its country to be performed live via the Eurovision and Euroradio networks, and then casts votes for the other countries' songs to determine a winner.

zh.t: 首届欧洲歌唱大赛在瑞士卢加诺举行
zh.s: 欧洲歌唱大赛（简称ESC；法语：Concours Eurovision de la chanson），通常简称“Eurovision”，是欧洲广播联盟（EBU）自1956年起每年举办的国际歌曲比赛。各参赛广播机构提交代表本国的原创歌曲，通过欧洲歌唱大赛和Euroradio网络进行现场直播，之后为其他国家的歌曲投票以决定胜者。

en.s: Operation 17 Agustus (Indonesian: Operasi 17 Agustus) was a military operation led by Colonel Ahmad Yani which aimed to crush the Revolutionary Government of the Republic of Indonesia (PRRI) movement in West Sumatra, specifically in Padang. This military operation is a joint operation involving the Indonesian Navy, Army and Air Force. "August 17" refers to the password used by Colonel Ahmad Yani.

en.s: The 1972 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match between Scottish team Rangers and Soviet team Dynamo Moscow. It took place at the Camp Nou in Barcelona on 24 May 1972 in front of a crowd of 35,000. It was the final of the 1971–72 European Cup Winners' Cup, one of three football competitions run by UEFA at the time.

zh.s: 1972年欧洲优胜者杯决赛是一场由苏格兰流浪者队对阵苏联莫斯科迪纳摩队的足球比赛。比赛于1972年5月24日在巴塞罗那诺坎普球场举行，现场观众3.5万人。这是1971—72赛季欧洲优胜者杯决赛。当时欧洲足联共有三项足球赛事。

en.s: Spaghetti Junction, officially the Gravelly Hill Interchange, is a major road junction in Birmingham, England. It is junction 6 of the M6 motorway where it meets the A38(M) Aston Expressway in the Gravelly Hill area of Birmingham. The interchange was opened on 24 May 1972.

zh.t: 伯明翰“意大利面交汇处”通车
zh.s: “意大利面交汇处”的正式名称是格雷夫利山立交，是英国伯明翰的一处大型道路交汇枢纽，位于伯明翰格雷夫利山地区，是M6高速公路第6号交汇处，并连接A38(M)阿斯顿快速路。该立交于1972年5月24日开放通车。

en.s: The West Bromwich by-election of 24 May 1973 was held after the appointment of Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Maurice Foley to the European Commission. Held continuously by Labour since 1935 it was retained in this by-election.

zh.s: 1973年5月24日，西布罗米奇举行补选。工党议员莫里斯·福利获任欧盟委员会委员，触发了这次补选。工党自1935年以来一直控制该席位，并在本次补选中保住席位。

en.s: General elections were due to be held in Malawi on 24 May 1976. The Malawi Congress Party had been the only legally permitted party since 1966. Each of the 70 constituencies had a maximum of five candidates proposed by at least two registered voters. These candidates were then submitted to President-for-life Hastings Banda, who selected a single candidate for each seat. As a result, all 70 candidates were returned unopposed. Following the election, Banda nominated another 15 members to the National Assembly.

zh.s: 马拉维原定于1976年5月24日举行大选。马拉维国会党自1966年以来是唯一合法政党。每个选区最多可有五名候选人，由至少两名登记选民提名。候选人名单随后提交终身总统海斯廷斯·班达，由他为每个席位选定一名候选人。因此，70名候选人均未经竞争当选。选举结束后，班达又任命15名国民议会议员。

en.s: The 1978 Bulgarian Cup final was the 38th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between CSKA Sofia and Marek Dupnitsa on 24 May 1978 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Marek won the final 1–0.

zh.s: 1978年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第38届决赛。当时赛事名为苏联军队杯。索非亚中央陆军与杜普尼察马雷克于1978年5月24日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场对阵，杜普尼察马雷克以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1980 Kemabong by-election is a by-election for the Sabah State Legislative Assembly seat of Kemabong that were held from 21 to 24 May 1980. It was called following the resignation of the incumbent, Asmawi Chew on 11 March 1980. The by election were held on the same dates as 1980 Sugut by-election.
en.n: The 1980 Kemabong by-election is a by-election for the Sabah State Legislative Assembly seat of Kemabong that were held from 21 to 24 May 1980.

zh.s: 1980年基马邦补选是沙巴州议会基马邦选区的一次补选，于1980年5月21日至24日举行。时任议员阿斯马维·丘于1980年3月11日辞职，引发了这次补选。选举日期与1980年苏古特补选相同。
zh.n: 1980年基马邦补选是沙巴州议会基马邦选区于1980年5月21日至24日举行的一次补选。

en.s: The 1980 Sugut by-election is a by-election for the Sabah State Legislative Assembly seat of Sugut that were held from 21 to 24 May 1980. en.n: The 1980 Sugut by-election is a by-election for the Sabah State Legislative Assembly seat of Sugut that were held from 21 to 24 May 1980.

zh.s: 1980年苏古特补选是沙巴州议会苏古特选区的一次补选，于1980年5月21日至24日举行。时任议员贝图阿·阿巴于1980年3月11日辞职，引发了这次补选。选举日期与1980年基马邦补选相同。
zh.n: 1980年苏古特补选是沙巴州议会苏古特选区于1980年5月21日至24日举行的一次补选。

en.s: The Second Battle of Khorramshahr, also known in Iran as the Liberation of Khorramshahr (Persian: آزادسازی خرمشهر, romanized: Âzâdsâzī-ye Khorramshahr) was the Iranian recapture of the city of Khorramshahr on 24 May 1982, during the Iran–Iraq War. The city had been captured by the Iraqis earlier in the war, on 26 October 1980, shortly after the Iraqi invasion of Iran.

zh.s: 第二次霍拉姆沙赫尔战役在伊朗又称“解放霍拉姆沙赫尔”，是伊朗军队于1982年5月24日在两伊战争期间收复霍拉姆沙赫尔的战役。伊拉克军队在战争早期、即1980年10月26日入侵伊朗后不久便占领了该城。

en.s: Operation Beit-ol-Moqaddas (Persian: عملیات بیت‌المقدس; Operation Jerusalem), also known as the Operation Toward Beit-ol-Moqaddas (عملیات الی بیت‌المقدس), was an Iranian operation conducted during the Iran–Iraq War. The operation was a success, as it achieved its standing aim of liberating Khorramshahr and pushed Iraqi troops back to the border. This operation, coupled with Operation Tariq-ol-Qods, and Operation Fath-ol-Mobin, succeeded in evicting Iraqi troops from southern Iran and gave Iran the momentum, making them extremely significant events.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷行动（波斯语：عملیات بیت‌المقدس；英文名：Operation Jerusalem）又称“向耶路撒冷进军行动”（波斯语：عملیات الی بیت‌المقدس），是两伊战争期间伊朗发动的一次军事行动。行动成功达成原定目标，收复霍拉姆沙赫尔，并将伊拉克军队赶回边境。此次行动与“塔里克·库德斯行动”和“法赫尔·莫宾行动”共同将伊拉克军队逐出伊朗南部，为伊朗赢得战场主动权，因此意义重大。

en.s: The 1984 Associate Members' Cup final was the final of the inaugural Associate Members' Cup. The match was held at Boothferry Park in Hull on 24 May 1984 and had an attendance of 6,544. It was contested by Hull City and Bournemouth. Bournemouth won the match 2–1, with Paul Morrell scoring the winning goal.

zh.s: 1984年英格兰联赛会员杯决赛是这项赛事的首届决赛。比赛于1984年5月24日在赫尔的布斯费里公园举行，现场观众6544人。对阵双方是赫尔城和伯恩茅斯，伯恩茅斯以2比1获胜，保罗·莫雷尔攻入制胜球。

en.s: The 1986 Associate Members' Cup Final, known as the Freight Rover Trophy for sponsorship reasons, was the 3rd final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from the Third Division and Fourth Division. The final was played at Wembley Stadium, London on 24 May 1986, and was contested by Bristol City and Bolton Wanderers. Bristol City won the match 3–0.

zh.s: 1986年英格兰联赛会员杯决赛因赞助原因也称Freight Rover杯决赛，是这项面向英格兰足球联赛第三级和第四级球队的国内杯赛第3届决赛。比赛于1986年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由布里斯托尔城对阵博尔顿流浪者。布里斯托尔城以3比0获胜。

en.s: National Council elections were held in the Czech part of Czechoslovakia on 23 and 24 May 1986.

zh.s: 1986年5月23日至24日，捷克斯洛伐克的捷克地区举行国民议会选举。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Czechoslovakia on 23 and 24 May 1986. The National Front put forward a single list of candidates for both the House of the People (the lower house) and the House of Nations (the upper house) and one NF candidate ran in each single member constituency.

zh.s: 1986年5月23日至24日，捷克斯洛伐克举行议会选举。民族阵线为人民院（下院）和民族院（上院）分别提出一份统一候选人名单，并在每个单一议席选区只提名一名民族阵线候选人。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Slovak Socialist Republic on 23 and 24 May 1986 alongside national elections. All 150 seats in the National Council were won by the National Front. The Communist Party of Slovakia, the Party of Slovak Revival, the Freedom Party and independents were all represented in Parliament.

zh.s: 1986年5月23日至24日，斯洛伐克社会主义共和国举行议会选举，与全国选举同期进行。国民议会全部150席均由民族阵线赢得。斯洛伐克共产党、斯洛伐克复兴党、自由党和无党派人士均在议会中有代表。

en.s: The 1987 Associate Members' Cup Final, known as the Freight Rover Trophy for sponsorship reasons, was the 4th final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from the Third Division and Fourth Division. The final was played at Wembley Stadium, London on 24 May 1987, and was contested by Bristol City and Mansfield Town. With the score tied at 1–1 after extra time, Mansfield Town won the match in a penalty shootout.

zh.s: 1987年英格兰联赛会员杯决赛因赞助原因也称Freight Rover杯决赛，是这项面向英格兰足球联赛第三级和第四级球队的国内杯赛第4届决赛。比赛于1987年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由布里斯托尔城对阵曼斯菲尔德城。加时赛后双方战成1比1，曼斯菲尔德城在点球大战中获胜。

en.t: Section 28 of the United Kingdom's Local Government Act of 1988, a controversial amendment stating that a local authority cannot intentionally promote homosexuality, was enacted
en.s: Section 28 of the Local Government Act 1988 provided that local authorities in England, Scotland and Wales should "not intentionally promote homosexuality or publish material with the intention of promoting homosexuality" or "promote the teaching in any maintained school of the acceptability of homosexuality as a pretended family relationship". While the bill was in progress, the relevant portion was Clause 28.

zh.t: 英国《地方政府法》中的第28条生效
zh.s: 1988年《地方政府法》第28条规定，英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士的地方政府不得“故意宣扬同性恋，或发布意在宣扬同性恋的材料”，也不得“在公立学校宣扬同性恋关系可以被接受，并将其称作一种虚假的家庭关系”。该法案审议期间，相关条款曾编号为第28条草案。

en.s: The 1989 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Slavi Aleksiev Stadium in Pleven on 24 May 1989, and was contested between the sides of CSKA Sofia and Chernomorets Burgas. The match was won by CSKA.

zh.s: 1989年5月24日，索非亚中央陆军和布尔加斯黑海人队在普列文的斯拉维·阿列克谢耶夫球场举行保加利亚杯决赛。索非亚中央陆军获胜。

en.s: The 1989 European Cup final was a football match played at the Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain, on 24 May 1989 that saw Milan of Italy defeat Steaua București of Romania 4–0. Two goals each from Ruud Gullit and Marco Van Basten gave the Rossoneri their third European Cup title and the first in 20 years.

zh.s: 1989年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1989年5月24日在西班牙巴塞罗那的诺坎普球场举行。意大利AC米兰以4比0击败罗马尼亚布加勒斯特星队。鲁德·古利特和马尔科·范巴斯滕各进两球，帮助“红黑军团”赢得队史第三座欧洲冠军杯，也是时隔20年再次夺冠。

en.s: Two by-elections for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Bootle were held in 1990; the first on 24 May, and the second on 8 November. The first by-election, caused by the death of incumbent Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) Allan Roberts, was won by Labour candidate Michael Carr. On 20 July, Carr died after just 57 days in office, triggering another by-election which was won by Joe Benton, who once again held the seat for Labour.

zh.s: 1990年，英国布特尔选区举行了两次议会补选：第一次于5月24日举行，第二次于11月8日举行。首轮补选因工党现任议员艾伦·罗伯茨去世而举行，工党候选人迈克尔·卡尔当选。7月20日，卡尔上任仅57天后去世，引发第二次补选；工党候选人乔·本顿当选，工党再次保住该席位。

en.s: Operation Solomon (Hebrew: מבצע שלמה, Mivtza Shlomo) was a covert Israeli military operation from May 24 to 25, 1991, to airlift Ethiopian Jews to Israel. Non-stop flights of 35 Israeli aircraft, including Israeli Air Force C-130s and El Al Boeing 747s, transported 14,325 Ethiopian Jews to Israel in 36 hours.

zh.s: 所罗门行动（希伯来语：מבצע שלמה，Mivtza Shlomo）是以色列于1991年5月24日至25日秘密实施的一次军事行动，目的是将埃塞俄比亚犹太人空运至以色列。以色列出动35架飞机，包括空军C-130运输机和以色列航空波音747客机，在36小时内运送了14,325名埃塞俄比亚犹太人。

en.s: General elections were held in Kosovo on 24 May 1992 to elect a President and Assembly. The overwhelming majority in the Assembly was won by the Democratic League of Kosovo (LDK), while its leader Ibrahim Rugova was elected President of Kosovo.

zh.s: 1992年5月24日，科索沃举行大选，选出总统和议会。科索沃民主联盟在议会中赢得压倒性多数，其领袖易卜拉欣·鲁戈瓦当选科索沃总统。

en.s: The 1992 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1991–92 Taça de Portugal, the 52nd season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 24 May 1992 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides from the same city: Boavista and Porto.

zh.s: 1992年葡萄牙杯决赛是1991—92赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，也是这项葡萄牙足球顶级杯赛第52个赛季的决赛。赛事由葡萄牙足球协会（FPF）主办。比赛于1992年5月24日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，对阵双方是来自同一城市波尔图的两支葡超球队博阿维斯塔和波尔图。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Austria on 26 April 1992, with a second round held on 24 May 1992 after no candidate won a majority in the first round. Incumbent president Kurt Waldheim did not seek reelection as he had not gained acceptance in the international community. The strongest party at that time, the Social Democratic Party, proposed the current minister of traffic and nationalized industries, Rudolf Streicher, for the office, while the Austrian People's Party put up career diplomat Thomas Klestil.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥地利于1992年4月26日举行总统选举。由于首轮没有候选人获得过半数选票，第二轮于5月24日举行。时任总统库尔特·瓦尔德海姆因未获国际社会认可而没有寻求连任。当时支持率最高的社会民主党提名时任交通与国有工业部长鲁道夫·施特赖歇尔参选，奥地利人民党则提名职业外交官托马斯·克莱斯蒂尔。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.t: Roman Catholic Cardinal Juan Jesús Posadas Ocampo and five other people are assassinated in a shootout at Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla Guadalajara International Airport in Mexico
en.s: Juan Jesús Posadas Ocampo (11 November 1926 – 24 May 1993) was an archbishop of the Catholic Church in Mexico who served as the eighth archbishop of the see of Guadalajara and as a cardinal of the Catholic Church. Posadas Ocampo was elevated to the cardinalate by Pope John Paul II on the consistory of 28 June 1991.

zh.t: 天主教枢机主教胡安·赫苏斯·波萨达斯·奥坎波等6人在墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉国际机场枪战中遇刺
zh.s: 胡安·赫苏斯·波萨达斯·奥坎波（1926年11月11日—1993年5月24日）是墨西哥天主教会大主教，曾任瓜达拉哈拉总教区第八任总主教，并获任枢机主教。教宗若望·保禄二世于1991年6月28日的枢密会议上擢升他为枢机。

en.s: Knight Air Flight 816, operated by an Embraer 110 Bandeirante belonging to Knight Air, was a domestic scheduled flight operating between Leeds Bradford and Aberdeen airports on 24 May 1995, which crashed shortly after take-off, with the loss of all on board.

zh.s: 骑士航空816号班机由一架属于骑士航空的巴西航空工业公司EMB-110“班代兰特”型飞机执飞，是一趟定期国内航班，往返于利兹布拉德福德机场和阿伯丁机场。1995年5月24日，飞机在起飞后不久坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。

en.s: The 1995 UEFA Champions League final was an association football match played on 24 May 1995 at the Ernst-Happel-Stadion in Vienna, Austria, to determine the winners of the 1994–95 UEFA Champions League, the 40th season of Europe's premier club competition organised by UEFA. It was contested by Dutch side Ajax and title holders Milan of Italy in a rematch of the 1969 final.

zh.s: 1995年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于1995年5月24日在奥地利维也纳的恩斯特·哈佩尔体育场举行，决出1994至1995赛季欧洲足联顶级俱乐部赛事、即第40届欧冠冠军。对阵双方是荷兰阿贾克斯和意大利卫冕冠军AC米兰，重演1969年决赛。

en.t: 1997 Football League Third Division play-off final
en.s: The 1997 Football League Third Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 24 May 1997 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Northampton Town and Swansea City to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Third Division to the Second Division.

zh.t: 1997年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1997年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛于1997年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是北安普敦镇和斯旺西城。比赛决出最后一支升级球队，从英格兰足球联赛第三级升入第二级。

en.s: The 1997 Scottish Cup Final was the 112th final of the Scottish Cup, Scottish football's most prestigious knockout association football competition. The match took place at Ibrox Stadium in Glasgow on 24 May 1997 and was contested by Scottish Premier Division club Kilmarnock and Scottish Division One club Falkirk. It was Kilmarnock's eighth Scottish Cup Final and Falkirk's third.

zh.s: 1997年苏格兰杯决赛是苏格兰最重要的淘汰制足球赛事第112届决赛。比赛于1997年5月24日在格拉斯哥伊布罗克斯球场举行，由苏格兰超级联赛球队基尔马诺克对阵苏格兰甲级联赛球队福尔柯克。这是基尔马诺克第8次闯入苏格兰杯决赛，也是福尔柯克第3次闯入决赛。

en.t: 1998 Hong Kong legislative election in New Territories East
en.s: These are the New Territories East results of the 1998 Hong Kong legislative election. The election was held on 24 May 1998 and all 5 seats in newly established constituency New Territories East where consisted of North District, Tai Po District, Sai Kung District and Sha Tin District were contested. The Frontier became the largest victors by winning two seats with Emily Lau and Cyd Ho, which was followed by the Democratic Party's Andrew Cheng.

zh.t: 1998年香港立法会新界东选区选举
zh.s: 这是1998年香港立法会选举新界东选区的结果。选举于1998年5月24日举行，新成立的新界东地方选区争夺全部5席，范围包括北区、大埔区、西贡区和沙田区。前线党赢得两席，成为最大赢家，刘慧卿和何秀兰当选。民主党的郑家富也当选。

en.t: 1998 Hong Kong legislative election in Hong Kong Island
en.s: These are the Hong Kong Island results of the 1998 Hong Kong legislative election. The election was held on 24 May 1998 and all 4 seats in the newly established Hong Kong Island geographical constituency were contested. The Democratic Party became the biggest winner by taking two seats with Martin Lee and Yeung Sum elected, which followed by Democratic Alliance for the Betterment of Hong Kong's (DAB) Cheng Kai-nam and Citizens Party's Christine Loh.

zh.t: 1998年香港立法会香港岛选区选举
zh.s: 这是1998年香港立法会选举香港岛选区的结果。选举于1998年5月24日举行，新设的香港岛地方选区争夺全部4席。民主党赢得两席，李柱铭和杨森当选；香港民主建港联盟的郑基恩和公民党的陆恭蕙也当选。

en.t: 1998 Hong Kong legislative election in Kowloon East
en.s: These are the Kowloon East results of the 1998 Hong Kong legislative election. The election was held on 24 May 1998 and all 3 seats in Kowloon East where consisted of Wong Tai Sin District and Kwun Tong District were contested. The Szeto Wah-led Democratic Party won two seats, with Fred Li got elected, while Chan Yuen-han of the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment of Hong Kong was also elected.

zh.t: 1998年香港立法会九龙东选区选举
zh.s: 这是1998年香港立法会选举九龙东选区的结果。选举于1998年5月24日举行，九龙东选区全部3席进行改选，范围包括黄大仙区和观塘区。司徒华领导的民主党赢得两席，李华明当选；香港民主建港联盟的陈婉娴也当选。

en.t: 1998 Hong Kong legislative election in New Territories West
en.s: These are the New Territories West results of the 1998 Hong Kong legislative election. The election was held on 24 May 1998 and all 6 seats in the newly established New Territories West, which consists of Tsuen Wan District, Tuen Mun District, Yuen Long District, Kwai Tsing District and Islands District, were contested.

zh.t: 1998年香港立法会新界西选区选举
zh.s: 这是1998年香港立法会选举新界西选区的结果。选举于1998年5月24日举行，新设的新界西选区争夺全部6席，范围包括荃湾区、屯门区、元朗区、葵青区和离岛区。

en.t: 1998 Hong Kong legislative election in Kowloon West
en.s: These are the Kowloon West results of the 1998 Hong Kong legislative election. The election was held on 24 May 1998 and all 3 seats in Kowloon West where consisted of Yau Tsim Mong District, Sham Shui Po District and Kowloon City District were contested. The Democratic Party's Lau Chin-shek and James To won two seats and was followed by Jasper Tsang of the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment of Hong Kong.

zh.t: 1998年香港立法会九龙西选区选举
zh.s: 这是1998年香港立法会选举九龙西选区的结果。选举于1998年5月24日举行，九龙西选区全部3席进行改选，范围包括油尖旺区、深水埗区和九龙城区。民主党的刘千石和涂谨申赢得两席，其后是香港民主建港联盟的曾钰成。

en.t: 1998 Football League Second Division play-off final
en.s: The 1998 Football League Second Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 24 May 1998 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Grimsby Town and Northampton Town. The top two teams of the 1997–98 Football League Second Division league, Watford and Bristol City, gained automatic promotion to the First Division, while those placed from third to sixth place in the table took part in play-offs.

zh.t: 1998年英格兰足球联赛第二级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1998年英格兰足球联赛第二级附加赛决赛于1998年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是格里姆斯比镇和北安普敦镇。1997至1998赛季排名前两位的沃特福德和布里斯托尔城直接升入第一级，排名第三至第六的球队则参加附加赛。

en.s: The 1998 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1997–98 Taça de Portugal, the 58th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 24 May 1998 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides Braga and Porto.

zh.s: 1998年葡萄牙杯决赛是1997—98赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，也是这项葡萄牙足球顶级杯赛第58个赛季的决赛。赛事由葡萄牙足球协会（FPF）主办。比赛于1998年5月24日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，对阵双方是葡超球队布拉加和波尔图。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 10 May 1998, with a second round of voting in 175 of the 176 single member constituencies on 24 May. Although the Hungarian Socialist Party received the most votes, the then-liberal conservative Fidesz won the most seats. The successful breakthrough into parliament by the extreme right-wing Hungarian Justice and Life Party was also a major shock.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1998年5月10日举行国会选举，176个单一议席选区中有175个于5月24日举行第二轮投票。尽管匈牙利社会党获得的选票最多，当时持自由保守派立场的青民盟赢得的议席最多。极右翼匈牙利正义与生活党成功进入国会，也令许多人震惊。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2000 UEFA Champions League final was a football match that took place on 24 May 2000. The match was played at Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France, to determine the winner of the 1999–2000 UEFA Champions League. Spanish teams Real Madrid (playing in their eleventh final in the competition) and Valencia (in their maiden appearance at this stage) were the participants in the first final in the history of the European Cup or Champions League to feature two clubs from the same country.

zh.s: 2000年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于2000年5月24日举行，在法国圣但尼的法兰西体育场进行，决出1999—2000赛季欧洲冠军联赛冠军。对阵双方是西班牙球队皇家马德里和瓦伦西亚。皇家马德里第11次闯入该项赛事决赛，瓦伦西亚则首次闯入决赛；这是欧洲冠军杯或欧洲冠军联赛历史上首次出现两支同国球队争夺冠军。

en.s: The 2001 Bulgarian Cup final was played at Stadion Lokomotiv in Sofia on 24 May 2001 and was contested between the sides of Litex Lovech and Velbazhd Kyustendil. The match was won by Litex Lovech, with Stefan Yurukov scoring the golden goal in the 91st minute.

zh.s: 2001年保加利亚杯决赛于2001年5月24日在索非亚的洛科莫蒂夫球场举行，对阵双方是洛维奇足球俱乐部和丘斯滕迪尔韦尔巴日德队。洛维奇获胜，斯特凡·尤鲁科夫在第91分钟打入金球。

en.s: The Treaty Between the United States of America and the Russian Federation on Strategic Offensive Reductions (SORT), also known as the Treaty of Moscow, was a strategic arms reduction treaty between the United States and Russia that was in force from June 2003 until February 2011 when it was superseded by the New START treaty. At the time, SORT was positioned as "represent[ing] an important element of the new strategic relationship" between the two countries with both parties agreeing to limit their nuclear arsenal to between 1,700 and 2,200 operationally deployed warheads each. It was signed in Moscow on 24 May 2002.

zh.t: 美俄《削减进攻性战略武器条约》
zh.s: 《美利坚合众国与俄罗斯联邦削减进攻性战略武器条约》（SORT）又称《莫斯科条约》，是美国与俄罗斯之间的一项削减战略武器条约，于2003年6月生效，2011年2月被新削减战略武器条约取代。SORT当时被称为“构成两国新战略关系的重要组成部分”；双方同意将各自实际部署的核弹头数量限制在1700至2200枚之间。条约于2002年5月24日在莫斯科签署。

en.t: 2003 Football League Third Division play-off final
en.s: The 2003 Football League Third Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 24 May 2003 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff, Wales, between Bournemouth and Lincoln City to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Third Division to the Second Division.

zh.t: 2003年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2003年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛于2003年5月24日在威尔士卡迪夫千禧球场举行，对阵双方是伯恩茅斯和林肯城。比赛决出最后一支升级球队，从英格兰足球联赛第三级升入第二级。

en.s: The 2003 Heineken Cup Final was the final match of the 2002–03 Heineken Cup, the eighth season of Europe's top club rugby union competition. The match was played on 24 May 2003 at Lansdowne Road in Dublin. The match was contested by Toulouse and Perpignan. Toulouse became the second team to win the competition more than once, winning the match 22–17.

zh.s: 2003年喜力杯决赛是2002—03赛季喜力杯的决赛，也是这项欧洲顶级俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第8个赛季的收官战。比赛于2003年5月24日在都柏林兰斯当路球场举行，由图卢兹对阵佩皮尼昂。图卢兹以22比17获胜，成为第二支不止一次夺得该赛事冠军的球队。

en.s: The 2006 Bulgarian Cup final was the 66th final of the Bulgarian Cup. The match took place on 24 May 2006 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. The match was contested by CSKA Sofia, who beat Naftex Burgas 4–1 in their semi-final, and Cherno More Varna who beat Volov Shumen 2–1 after extra time. CSKA won the final 3–1.

zh.s: 2006年保加利亚杯决赛是该项赛事第66届决赛。比赛于2006年5月24日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行。对阵双方是索非亚中央陆军和瓦尔纳切尔诺莫雷；前者在半决赛中以4比1击败布尔加斯纳夫泰克斯，后者则在加时赛后以2比1击败舒门沃洛夫。最终索非亚中央陆军以3比1获胜。

en.t: An Inconvenient Truth, a documentary film that has been credited for raising international public awareness of climate change and re-energizing the environmental movement, was released
en.s: An Inconvenient Truth is a 2006 American documentary film directed by Davis Guggenheim about former vice president of the United States Al Gore's campaign to educate people about global warming. The film features a slide show that, by Gore's own estimate, he has presented over 1,000 times to audiences worldwide.

zh.t: 纪录片《难以忽视的真相》上映，提高国际公众对气候变化的关注并推动环保运动复兴
zh.s: 《难以忽视的真相》是2006年上映的美国纪录片，由戴维斯·古根海姆执导，讲述美国前副总统阿尔·戈尔开展的全球变暖科普活动。影片包含一场幻灯片演讲；据戈尔本人估计，他已在世界各地向观众展示该演讲超过1,000次。

en.s: (This article is about the general election in the Republic of Ireland. For the assembly election in Northern Ireland, see Northern Ireland Assembly election, 2007.) The Irish general election of 2007 took place on 24 May 2007 after the dissolution of the 29th Dáil by the President on 30 April 2007, at the request of the Taoiseach. The electorate was given the task of choosing the members of the 30th Dáil who met on 14 June 2007 to nominate a Taoiseach and ratify the ministers of the Government of the 30th Dáil. While Fine Gael gained 20 seats, Fianna Fáil remained the largest party.

zh.s: 2007年5月24日，爱尔兰共和国举行大选。爱尔兰总统应总理请求，于4月30日解散第29届达伊尔议会，随后举行选举。选民选出第30届达伊尔议会成员；新议会于2007年6月14日召开会议，提名总理并确认第30届政府的部长人选。统一党增加20席，但爱尔兰共和党仍是最大党。

en.s: The 2007 Bulgarian Cup final was the final match of the 2006–07 edition of the Bulgarian Cup competition. It was the 67th consecutive Bulgarian Cup final match. The defending cup holders CSKA Sofia were eliminated at the quarter-final stage by Beroe Stara Zagora. The match was held on 24 May 2007 at the Stadion Beroe in Stara Zagora, Bulgaria.

zh.s: 2007年保加利亚杯决赛是2006—07赛季该项赛事的决赛，也是连续举行的第67届保加利亚杯决赛。卫冕冠军索非亚中央陆军在四分之一决赛阶段被旧扎戈拉贝罗淘汰。决赛于2007年5月24日在保加利亚旧扎戈拉的贝罗球场举行。

en.s: UFC 84: Ill Will was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) on May 24, 2008, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada.

zh.s: UFC 84：不良意志是一场终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2008年5月24日在内华达州拉斯维加斯的米高梅大花园竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2008 Scottish Cup Final was a football match which took place at Hampden Park in Glasgow on 24 May 2008. The match was the final of the 123rd Scottish Cup and was contested by Queen of the South and Rangers. Rangers won the match 3–2. Queen of the South beat Aberdeen 4–3 in their semi-final, Rangers beat St Johnstone 4–3 on penalties after the match had ended 1–1 after extra time.

zh.s: 2008年苏格兰杯决赛于2008年5月24日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，是第123届苏格兰杯决赛。南方女王队对阵格拉斯哥流浪者队，流浪者以3比2获胜。南方女王在半决赛中以4比3击败阿伯丁；流浪者则在半决赛加时赛后以1比1战平圣约翰斯通，随后在点球大战中以4比3获胜。

en.s: The 2008 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 24 May 2008 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Hull City and Bristol City. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.s: 2008年英格兰足球联赛冠军锦标赛附加赛决赛于2008年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由赫尔城对阵布里斯托尔城。比赛决出最后一支升级球队，从英格兰足球第二级别的冠军锦标赛升入英超联赛。

en.s: The 2008 Coupe de France final was a football match that was held at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France on 24 May 2008. It was the 90th final in the Coupe de France's history. The final was contested between Paris Saint-Germain and Olympique Lyonnais. This was PSG's 10th appearance in the Coupe de France final, having won the cup in 1982, 1983, 1993, 1995, 1998, 2004, and 2006.

zh.s: 2008年法国杯决赛于2008年5月24日在法国圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行，是法国杯历史上的第90届决赛。对阵双方是巴黎圣日耳曼和里昂奥林匹克。巴黎圣日耳曼第10次打入决赛，此前曾于1982、1983、1993、1995、1998、2004和2006年夺冠。

en.s: The 2008 Sokoto State gubernatorial by-election occurred on May 24, 2008. PDP candidate Aliyu Magatakarda Wamakko won the election, defeating DPP Muhammed Dingyadi and other candidates.

zh.s: 2008年5月24日，尼日利亚索科托州举行州长补选。人民民主党候选人阿利尤·马加塔卡达·瓦马克科击败民主人民党候选人穆罕默德·丁加迪等人，当选州长。

en.s: The 2008 Bayelsa State gubernatorial election occurred on May 24, 2008. Incumbent PDP Governor Timipre Sylva won re-election in the supplementary election, defeating AC candidate, Ebitimi Amgbare, to emerge winner. Sylva won in six LGAs of the state. Timipre Sylva emerged winner in the PDP gubernatorial primary election. His running mate was Peremobowei Ebebi.

zh.s: 2008年5月24日，尼日利亚巴耶尔萨州举行州长补选。在这次补充选举中，时任州长、人民民主党（PDP）候选人蒂米普雷·席尔瓦击败行动大会党（AC）候选人埃比蒂米·安姆加巴雷，成功连任，并在该州6个地方政府区获胜。席尔瓦此前赢得人民民主党州长候选人初选，竞选搭档是佩雷莫博韦·埃贝比。

en.s: The 2008 Heineken Cup Final was the final match of the 2007–08 Heineken Cup, the 13th season of Europe's top club rugby union competition. The match was played on 24 May 2008 at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff. The match was contested by Munster of Ireland and Toulouse of France. Munster won their second Heineken Cup title with a 16–13 win.

zh.s: 2008年喜力杯决赛是2007—08赛季喜力杯的决赛，也是这项欧洲顶级俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第13个赛季的收官战。比赛于2008年5月24日在加的夫千禧球场举行，由爱尔兰芒斯特对阵法国图卢兹。芒斯特以16比13获胜，第二次夺得喜力杯冠军。

en.s: The 2008 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2007–08 Coppa Italia, the top cup competition in Italian football. The match was played on 24 May 2008, between defending champions A.S. Roma and Internazionale at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome. This was the fourth consecutive and total final between these two clubs. Roma successfully defended their title as cup winners, defeating Inter by a score of 2–1.

zh.s: 2008年意大利杯决赛是2007—08赛季意大利杯的决赛，也是意大利足球的顶级杯赛赛事。比赛于2008年5月24日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，由卫冕冠军罗马对阵国际米兰。这是两队连续第4次在决赛相遇，也是双方总计第4次在决赛交手。罗马以2比1击败国际米兰，成功卫冕。

en.s: An Xtreme Pro Wrestling (XPW) reunion show called Cold Day in Hell took place on May 24, 2008, at Aviation Park in Redondo Beach, California. The event was originally going to be called "Hell Freezes Over", but was changed to "Cold Day in Hell". In June 2007, Big Vision Entertainment, the owners of XPW, worked on MTV's Wrestling Society X which featured many XPW alumni.

zh.s: 极限职业摔角（XPW）于2008年5月24日在加利福尼亚州雷东多海滩的航空公园举办了一场名为《地狱寒日》（Cold Day in Hell）的重聚赛事。赛事原名《地狱冻结》（Hell Freezes Over），后来更名为《地狱寒日》。2007年6月，XPW所有者大视野娱乐参与制作MTV节目《摔角协会X》，节目中有许多XPW旧将。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mongolia on 24 May 2009. They were contested between incumbent Nambaryn Enkhbayar, supported by the Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party, and Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj, who had support of the Democratic Party and the opposition parties. Elbegdorj declared himself the victor before the count was official but based on his party's counts. Enkhbayar admitted a narrow defeat shortly after and said that he would respect the results, marking the first time an incumbent president had lost their bid for re-election.

zh.s: 2009年5月24日，蒙古举行总统选举。参选者是现任总统那木巴尔·恩赫巴亚尔（获蒙古人民革命党支持）和查希亚·额勒贝格道尔吉（获民主党及反对党支持）。官方计票结果公布前，额勒贝格道尔吉依据其政党的统计宣布自己获胜。恩赫巴亚尔不久后承认以微弱差距落败，并表示会尊重选举结果。这是蒙古首位寻求连任的现任总统败选。

en.s: The 2009 Football League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 24 May 2009 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Millwall and Scunthorpe United to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from Football League One to the Football League Championship.

zh.t: 2009年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2009年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛于2009年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是米尔沃尔和斯肯索普联。比赛决出最后一支升级球队，从英格兰足球联赛第三级升入冠军锦标赛。

en.s: The 62nd Cannes Film Festival took place from 13 May to 24 May 2009. French actress Isabelle Huppert served as jury president for the main competition. Austrian filmmaker Michael Haneke won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the mystery drama film The White Ribbon. The festival opened with Up by Pete Docter, marking the first time that an animated film opened the festival, and closed with Coco Chanel & Igor Stravinsky by Jan Kounen.

zh.s: 第62届戛纳电影节于2009年5月13日至24日举行。法国女演员伊莎贝尔·于佩尔担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。奥地利导演迈克尔·哈内克凭剧情悬疑片《白丝带》获得电影节最高奖金棕榈奖。电影节以皮特·道格特执导的《飞屋环游记》开幕，这是动画电影首次成为戛纳电影节开幕片；电影节则以扬·库南执导的《可可香奈儿与伊戈尔·斯特拉文斯基》闭幕。

en.s: A general election was held in Trinidad and Tobago on May 24, 2010. The date of the general elections was announced by Prime Minister Patrick Manning on April 16, 2010, via a press release. The election was called over two years earlier than required by law. Polls showing that the UNC-led opposition coalition was likely to win the election were confirmed by the subsequent results. With preliminary results showing the People's Partnership coalition likely to win a majority of 29 out of a possible 41 seats, Patrick Manning conceded defeat on election night.

zh.s: 2010年5月24日，特立尼达和多巴哥举行大选。总理帕特里克·曼宁于4月16日通过新闻稿宣布选举日期；这次选举比法律要求提前两年多举行。民调显示，以联合民族大会党为首的反对派联盟很可能获胜，最终结果证实了这一预测。初步结果显示，人民伙伴联盟可能赢得41席中的29席并取得多数，帕特里克·曼宁在选举当晚承认败选。

en.t: New York's 26th congressional district special election, 2011
en.s: A 2011 special election in New York's 26th congressional district was held on May 24, 2011 to fill a seat in the U.S. Congress for New York's 26th congressional district. The vacancy was due to the February 2011 resignation of married Republican Chris Lee who resigned amid a scandal involving flirtatious emails and a shirtless picture he had sent to a woman he met on Craigslist. Four candidates competed in the election: Republican New York State Assembly member Jane Corwin; Democrat Erie County Clerk Kathy Hochul; Green Party candidate Ian Murphy, editor of the Buffalo Beast; and independent candidate Jack Davis, a businessman running on the Tea Party line (formerly registered as a Democrat).

zh.t: 2011年纽约州第26国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2011年5月24日，纽约州第26国会选区举行特别选举，填补美国国会中的空缺。共和党议员克里斯·李于2011年2月辞职；丑闻曝光后，他离开议席。丑闻涉及他给在Craigslist上认识的一名女性发送暧昧邮件和裸露上身照片。共有四名候选人参选：共和党纽约州众议员简·科温、民主党伊利县书记凯西·霍楚尔、绿党候选人布法罗野兽网站编辑伊恩·墨菲，以及以茶党名义参选的独立候选人、商人杰克·戴维斯；戴维斯此前登记为民主党人。

en.s: The 2011 Miami-Dade County mayoral special election took place on May 24, 2011 and June 28, 2011 after the recall of County Mayor Carlos Álvarez earlier that year. After a May 24 first round, former County Commissioner Carlos A. Giménez narrowly defeated Hialeah Mayor Julio Robaina in a June 28 runoff. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.t: 2011年迈阿密-戴德县县长特别选举
zh.s: 2011年迈阿密-戴德县县长特别选举于2011年5月24日和6月28日举行。此前，县长卡洛斯·阿尔瓦雷斯被罢免。5月24日首轮投票后，前县专员卡洛斯·A·希门尼斯在6月28日的第二轮投票中以微弱优势击败海厄利亚市长胡利奥·罗拜纳。此次选举不设党派。

en.t: 2011 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: There were four special elections in 2011 to fill vacant seats in the United States House of Representatives. Two seats switched parties, swapping from Republican to Democratic, and two other seats were held by the same parties.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Egypt in 2012, with the first round on 23 and 24 May 2012 and the second on 16 and 17 June. To date, these are the only democratic presidential elections in Egyptian history. The Muslim Brotherhood declared early 18 June 2012 that its candidate Mohamed Morsi had won, the first victory of an Islamist as head of state in the Arab world.

zh.s: 埃及于2012年举行总统选举，首轮投票于5月23日至24日举行，第二轮于6月16日至17日举行。这是迄今埃及历史上唯一一次民主总统选举。2012年6月18日，穆斯林兄弟会提前宣布其候选人穆罕默德·穆尔西胜选；他成为阿拉伯世界首位当选国家元首的伊斯兰主义者。

en.s: UFC 173: Barão vs. Dillashaw was a mixed martial arts event held at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada on May 24, 2014.

zh.s: UFC 173：巴朗对阵迪拉肖是一场综合格斗赛事，于2014年5月24日在内华达州拉斯维加斯的米高梅大花园竞技场举行。

en.s: On 24 May 2014, a gunman opened fire at the Jewish Museum of Belgium in Brussels, Belgium, killing four people. Three died at the scene; a fourth was taken to the hospital and died on 6 June. The attack is being investigated as terrorism by Belgian authorities. On 30 May, Mehdi Nemmouche, a 29-year-old French national of Algerian origin, was arrested at Marseille in connection with the shooting.

zh.t: 比利时犹太博物馆枪击案
zh.s: 2014年5月24日，一名枪手在比利时布鲁塞尔的犹太博物馆开枪，造成4人死亡。3人当场死亡；第4人被送往医院后于6月6日伤重不治。比利时当局将该案作为恐怖袭击调查。5月30日，一名29岁、拥有法国国籍的阿尔及利亚裔男子梅赫迪·内穆什在马赛被捕，涉嫌参与枪击案。

en.s: Elections to the European Parliament took place in Slovakia on 24 May 2014. It was the third European election which took place in Slovakia. Thirteen MEPs were elected from Slovakia using a proportional list system joining the other candidates elected as part of the wider 2014 European Parliament election The 'faster processing of interim results' was promised by the Slovak Office for Statistics because of a new electronic counting system.

zh.s: 2014年5月24日，斯洛伐克举行欧洲议会议员选举，这是该国第三次举行欧洲选举。斯洛伐克采用比例代表制名单投票，选出13名欧洲议会议员，加入2014年欧洲议会选举中其他国家选出的议员。由于引入新的电子计票系统，斯洛伐克统计局承诺加快公布初步结果。

en.t: 2014 European Parliament election in the Czech Republic
en.s: European Parliament elections were held in the Czech Republic on 23 and 24 May 2014. In total, 21 Members of the European Parliament were elected using proportional representation (single district D'Hondt with a 5% threshold). ANO won the election closely followed by the coalition of TOP 09 and STAN, themselves closely followed by ČSSD. A total of 7 parties gained seats, including the non-parliamentary Party of Free Citizens.

zh.s: 2014年5月23日至24日，捷克举行欧洲议会选举，共选出21名欧洲议会议员。该国采用比例代表制，在单一选区按顿特法分配席位，并设有5%的得票门槛。ANO党获胜，紧随其后的是TOP 09与STAN联盟，再后是社会民主党。共有7个政党赢得席位，其中包括未进入议会的自由公民党。

en.s: The 2014 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 24 May 2014 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Derby County and Queens Park Rangers. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the EFL Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.s: 2014年英格兰足球联赛冠军锦标赛附加赛决赛于2014年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是德比郡和女王公园巡游者。比赛决出最后一支升级球队，从英格兰足球第二级别的冠军锦标赛升入英超联赛。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Latvia to the European Parliament was held on 24 May 2014. Unity party won these elections, The party has won every European parliament election since, as of 2024.

zh.s: 2014年5月24日，拉脱维亚举行欧洲议会议员选举，选出该国代表团。团结党赢得选举，截至2024年，该党在此后的每届欧洲议会选举中均获胜。

en.s: The 2014 Heineken Cup Final was the final match of the 2013–14 Heineken Cup, the 19th and final season of Europe's top club rugby union competition. The Heineken Cup was replaced by a new top-level competition, the European Rugby Champions Cup, effective in 2014–15. The match, between Toulon and Saracens, was played on 24 May 2014 in the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff, Wales, kicking off at 5 pm (16:00 UTC).

zh.s: 2014年喜力杯决赛是2013—14赛季喜力杯的决赛，也是该项欧洲顶级俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第19个、也是最后一个赛季的收官战。自2014—15赛季起，喜力杯由新的顶级赛事欧洲橄榄球冠军杯取代。决赛由土伦对阵撒拉逊人，于2014年5月24日下午5时（协调世界时16时）在威尔士加的夫千禧球场举行。

en.s: The 2014 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2013–14 UEFA Champions League, the 59th season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 22nd season since it was renamed from the European Champion Clubs' Cup to the UEFA Champions League. The match took place on Saturday, 24 May 2014, at the Estádio da Luz in Lisbon, Portugal, between Spanish sides Real Madrid and Atlético Madrid.

zh.s: 2014年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2013—14赛季欧洲冠军联赛的决赛，为欧洲足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事第59个赛季的决赛，也是赛事从欧洲冠军俱乐部杯更名为欧洲冠军联赛后的第22个赛季的决赛。比赛于2014年5月24日（星期六）在葡萄牙里斯本光明球场举行，由西班牙球队皇家马德里对阵马德里竞技。

en.s: An earthquake occurred in the northern Aegean Sea between Greece and Turkey on May 24, 2014. It had a moment magnitude of 6.9 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). Serious damage was reported on the Turkish island of Imbros and the cities of Edirne and Çanakkale, as well as on the Greek island of Lemnos. The earthquake was felt in Bulgaria and southern Romania.

zh.s: 2014年5月24日，希腊与土耳其之间的北爱琴海发生地震，矩震级为6.9级，最大麦加利烈度为IX级（剧烈）。土耳其格克切岛，以及埃迪尔内和恰纳卡莱等城市受灾严重；希腊利姆诺斯岛也有严重损毁。保加利亚和罗马尼亚南部均有震感。

en.t: Malta votes in the 2014 European Parliament election
en.s: On May 24, 2014, Malta voted to elect six representatives to the European Parliament. It was the country’s third European Parliament election.

zh.t: 马耳他举行2014年欧洲议会选举

en.s: The 2015 Barcelona City Council election was held on Sunday, 24 May 2015, to elect the 10th Barcelona City Council, the unicameral local legislature of the municipality of Barcelona. At stake were all 41 seats in the City Council, determining the Mayor of Barcelona. It was part of the 2015 Spanish municipal elections. The election was won by the Barcelona in Common (BC) citizen platform, supported by Podemos, Initiative for Catalonia Greens-United and Alternative Left (ICV-EUiA) and Constituent Process (PC), and led by known activist and former PAH spokeswoman Ada Colau. Colau then went on to become the first female Mayor of Barcelona in history.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Poland on 10 and 24 May 2015. In the first round of voting, opposition Law and Justice (PiS) candidate Andrzej Duda received the greatest number of votes with a share of 34.76%, followed by incumbent president Bronisław Komorowski (with 33.77%), who ran as an independent with the endorsement of the Civic Platform (PO), which he had renounced his membership in after winning the 2010 elections. Independent candidate Paweł Kukiz came third with 20.80% of the votes. As no candidate had received more than 50% of the votes cast, a second round was held on 24 May between the two highest-placed candidates, Duda and Komorowski.

en.s: The 2017 Armenian Cup final was the 26th Armenian Cup Final, and the final match of the 2016–17 Armenian Cup. County Leitrim was divided into 3 local electoral areas (LEAs) to elect councillors for a five-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

zh.s: 2019年5月24日，爱尔兰利特里姆郡举行地方选举，改选郡议会全部18席。该郡划分为3个地方选区，议员任期五年，采用单记可转移投票制（PR-STV）的比例代表制选举。

en.t: 2019 Limerick City and County Council election
en.s: An election to all 40 seats on Limerick City and County Council was held on 24 May 2019 as part of the 2019 Irish local elections. Limerick City and County was divided into 6 local electoral areas (LEAs) to elect 40 councillors for a five-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

zh.s: 2019年5月24日，爱尔兰利默里克市郡议会举行地方选举，改选全部40席。该地区划分为6个地方选区，选出40名议员，任期五年，采用单记可转移投票制（PR-STV）的比例代表制。

en.s: An election to all 29 seats on Louth County Council was held on 24 May 2019 as part of the 2019 Irish local elections. County Louth was divided into 5 local electoral areas (LEAs) to elect councillors for a five-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

zh.s: 2019年5月24日，爱尔兰劳斯郡举行地方选举，改选郡议会全部29席。该郡划分为5个地方选区，议员任期五年，采用单记可转移投票制（PR-STV）的比例代表制选举。

en.s: An election to all 39 seats on Galway County Council was held on 24 May 2019 as part of the 2019 Irish local elections. County Galway was divided into 7 local electoral areas (LEAs) to elect councillors for a five-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

zh.s: 2019年5月24日，爱尔兰戈尔韦郡举行地方选举，改选郡议会全部39席。该郡划分为7个地方选区，议员任期五年，采用单记可转移投票制（PR-STV）的比例代表制选举。

en.s: On 24 May 2019, a fire occurred at a commercial complex in Sarthana Jakatnaka area of Surat in the Gujarat state of India. Twenty-two students died and 19 others were injured in an academic coaching centre located on the building's terrace. The fire was started by a short circuit on the ground floor; the students in the coaching centre were trapped by the destruction of a wooden staircase.

zh.s: 2019年5月24日，印度古吉拉特邦苏拉特市萨尔塔纳·贾卡特纳卡区的一处商业综合楼发生火灾。楼顶培训中心内有22名学生死亡、19人受伤。火灾由一楼短路引发，培训中心的学生被困，是因为木楼梯被烧毁。

en.s: On the night of 24 May 2021, the Malian Army led by Vice President Assimi Goïta captured President Bah N'daw, Prime Minister Moctar Ouane and Minister of Defence Souleymane Doucouré. Assimi Goïta, the head of the junta that led the 2020 Malian coup d'état, announced that N'daw and Ouane were stripped of their powers and that new elections would be held in 2022.

zh.s: 2021年5月24日晚，副总统阿西米·戈伊塔率领马里军队拘捕总统巴·恩多、总理莫克塔尔·瓦内和国防部长苏莱曼·杜库雷。戈伊塔是领导2020年马里政变的军政府首脑。他随后宣布，恩多和瓦内已被解除职务，并将于2022年举行新选举。

en.s: The Pekon clashes are a series of engagements between the Myanmar SAC junta and anti-coup factions in Pekon Township, Shan State. Three months after the military coup, Karen militias raided and occupied a police station in Mobye. In July 2022, the KNDF targeted an unnamed EAO due to the mistaken belief it was delivering food to the Tatmadaw.

zh.s: 佩孔冲突是缅甸国家管理委员会军政府与反政变势力在掸邦佩孔镇区发生的一系列交战。缅甸军事政变发生三个月后，克伦民兵突袭并占领了莫比耶的一处警察局。2022年7月，克伦尼民族防卫军误以为某个未具名的民族武装组织正向缅甸国防军运送粮食，因此对其发动袭击。

en.s: On May 24, 2022, a mass shooting occurred at Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, Texas, United States. Salvador Ramos, an 18-year-old former student of the school, fatally shot 19 students and 2 teachers, while injuring 18 others. Ramos was killed 77 minutes after entering the classroom by law enforcement officers.

zh.s: 2022年5月24日，美国德克萨斯州乌瓦尔迪市罗布小学发生大规模枪击案。该校前学生、18岁的萨尔瓦多·拉莫斯枪杀19名学生和2名教师，另有18人受伤。拉莫斯进入教室77分钟后被执法人员击毙。

en.s: The 2022 Israel State Cup final decided the winner of the 2021–22 Israel State Cup, the 86th season of the Israel State Cup. It was played on 24 May 2022 at the Teddy Stadium in Jerusalem, between Maccabi Haifa and Hapoel Be'er Sheva. Hapoel Beer Sheva beat Maccabi Haifa 3–1 in the penalties, after 2–2 in the game.

zh.s: 2022年以色列国家杯决赛决出了2021—22赛季以色列国家杯冠军，这是该项赛事第86届。比赛于2022年5月24日在耶路撒冷泰迪体育场举行，由海法马卡比对阵贝尔谢巴工人队。常规比赛以2比2结束，贝尔谢巴工人队在点球大战中以3比1击败海法马卡比。

en.s: The Vila Cruzeiro shootout (Portuguese: chacina da Vila Cruzeiro) took place on 24 May 2022 in the favela of the same name in Rio de Janeiro, during a joint operation by the Special Police Operations Battalion (BOPE), the Federal Police and the Federal Highway Police that resulted in at least 26 people killed by gunshots or cutting objects.

zh.t: 维拉克鲁塞罗枪击事件
zh.s: 2022年5月24日，里约热内卢同名贫民区维拉克鲁塞罗发生枪击事件。这是特种警察行动营（BOPE）、联邦警察和联邦公路警察联合行动的一部分，至少26人死于枪伤或利器伤。

en.s: The 2022 Augusta, Georgia mayoral election took place on June 21, 2022, following a primary election on May 24, 2022. Incumbent Mayor Hardie Davis was term-limited and could not run for re-election. A crowded field emerged to succeed him, with nine separate candidates running. In the primary election, former County Tax Commissioner Steven Kendrick narrowly placed first, winning 39.4 percent of the vote to businessman Garnett Johnson's 38.8 percent.

zh.s: 2022年奥古斯塔市长选举于6月21日举行，初选则在5月24日举行。时任市长哈迪·戴维斯受任期限制，不能竞选连任。共有9名候选人角逐市长职位。初选中，前县税务专员史蒂文·肯德里克以39.4%的得票率险胜商人加内特·约翰逊（38.8%），排名第一。
