en.s: The 2023 Romanian Cup final was the final match of the 2022–23 Cupa României and the 85th final of the Cupa României, Romania's premier football cup competition. It was played on 24 May 2023 at the Stadionul Municipal in Sibiu, between Sepsi OSK and Universitatea Cluj. At the end of the 90 minutes, the score was 0–0, so extra time was needed.

zh.s: 2023年罗马尼亚杯决赛是2022—23赛季罗马尼亚杯的决赛，也是该项罗马尼亚顶级足球杯赛的第85届决赛。比赛于2023年5月24日在锡比乌市政球场举行，由圣格奥尔基圣善与克卢日大学对阵。90分钟比赛结束时双方战成0比0，因此进入加时赛。

en.s: The 2023 Croatian Cup final between the Dalmatian rivals Hajduk Split and Šibenik was played on 24 May 2023 in Rijeka. Hajduk Split won the trophy with a result of 2–0. This was the last one-legged final until 2026.

zh.s: 2023年克罗地亚杯决赛由达尔马提亚地区的两支宿敌球队斯普利特海杜克和希贝尼克对阵，于2023年5月24日在里耶卡举行。斯普利特海杜克以2比0获胜夺冠。直到2026年，这仍是该赛事最后一场单场决胜的决赛。

en.s: The 2023 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2022–23 Coppa Italia, Italy's premier national football cup, the Coppa Italia. It was played on 24 May 2023 between Fiorentina and Internazionale. Inter won the match 2–1 for their second consecutive and ninth overall Coppa Italia title.

zh.s: 2023年意大利杯决赛是2022—23赛季意大利杯的决赛，也是意大利顶级足球杯赛的收官战。比赛于2023年5月24日举行，由佛罗伦萨对阵国际米兰。国际米兰以2比1获胜，连续第二年夺冠，队史第九次赢得意大利杯。

en.s: The 2023 Greek Cup final was the 79th final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 24 May 2023 at Panthessaliko Stadium. The contesting teams were AEK Athens and PAOK. It was AEK Athens' twenty-seventh Greek Cup final in their 99 years of existence and PAOK's twenty third Greek Cup final and third consecutive, of their 97-year history.

zh.s: 2023年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第79届决赛，于2023年5月24日在潘塞萨利科球场举行，对阵双方是雅典AEK和塞萨洛尼基PAOK。这是雅典AEK在其99年队史上第27次闯入希腊杯决赛；PAOK在其97年队史上第23次闯入决赛，也是连续第三年闯入决赛。

en.s: The 2023 Bulgarian Cup final was the final match of the 2022–23 Bulgarian Cup and the 83rd final of the Bulgarian Cup. The final took place on 24 May 2023 at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. On 16 May the date and venue has been confirmed. The clubs contesting the final were CSKA 1948 and Ludogorets Razgrad.

zh.s: 2023年保加利亚杯决赛是2022—23赛季该项赛事的决赛，也是保加利亚杯第83届决赛。比赛于2023年5月24日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行。比赛日期和地点已于5月16日确认。对阵双方是索非亚中央陆军1948和拉兹格勒卢多戈雷茨。

en.s: The 2024 OFC Men's Champions League final was the final match of the 2024 OFC Men's Champions League, the 23rd edition of the Oceanian Club Championship, Oceania's premier club football tournament organized by the Oceania Football Confederation (OFC), and the 18th season under the current OFC Men's Champions League name. The final was a single match between New Zealand's Auckland City and Tahiti's Pirae. The match took place at Stade Pater in Pirae on 24 May 2024.

zh.t: 2024年大洋洲男子冠军联赛决赛
zh.s: 2024年大洋洲男子冠军联赛决赛是2024年大洋洲男子冠军联赛的最后一场比赛。这是大洋洲俱乐部锦标赛第23届赛事，由大洋洲足球联合会（OFC）主办，也是以“大洋洲男子冠军联赛”之名举行的第18个赛季。决赛为单场比赛，于2024年5月24日在塔希提岛皮拉埃的帕特尔体育场举行，由新西兰奥克兰城对阵塔希提岛球队皮拉埃。

en.s: The 2024 A-Leagues All Stars Women game was an exhibition soccer match that was played on 24 May 2024, featuring an all-star team of the A-League against Super League club Arsenal at Docklands Stadium in Melbourne, Australia as part of Global Football Week Melbourne. It was the first edition of the A-Leagues All Stars game and the fourth of the A-Leagues All Stars Game.

zh.s: 2024年澳洲联赛全明星女足赛是一场表演赛，于2024年5月24日在澳大利亚墨尔本码头体育场举行。澳洲女子联赛全明星队对阵英格兰女子超级联赛俱乐部阿森纳队，赛事属于墨尔本全球足球周活动。这是澳洲联赛全明星赛的首届女足赛事，也是澳洲联赛全明星赛的第4届赛事。

en.s: The 2024 A-Leagues All Stars Men game was the fourth edition of the A-Leagues All Stars Game, and the first since the 2022 Game. It was held at Marvel Stadium in Melbourne on 24 May 2024 against English club Newcastle United as part of Global Football Week Melbourne.

zh.s: 2024年澳洲联赛全明星男足赛是澳洲联赛全明星赛第4届赛事，也是自2022年赛事以来首次举行。比赛于2024年5月24日在墨尔本漫威体育场举行，澳洲联赛全明星队对阵英格兰纽卡斯尔联队，属于墨尔本全球足球周活动。

en.s: The 2025 EFL Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 24 May 2025 at Wembley Stadium, London, that determined the third and final team to gain promotion from EFL Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.s: 2025年英冠附加赛决赛于2025年5月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行。这场足球赛决出了第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球冠军联赛（英格兰第二级联赛）升入英超的球队。

en.s: The 2025 Scottish Cup final was the final match of the 2024–25 Scottish Cup, the 140th edition of Scotland's most prestigious knockout football competition. It was contested by seven-time winners Aberdeen and 42-time winners and holders Celtic at Hampden Park, Glasgow, on 24 May 2025. Aberdeen defeated Celtic 4–3 on penalties, after both teams scored an own goal, winning the former its first major trophy since the 2013–14 Scottish League Cup, and their first Scottish Cup title since 1989–90.

zh.s: 2025年苏格兰杯决赛是2024—25赛季苏格兰杯、即苏格兰最重要的淘汰制足球赛事第140届的决赛。比赛于2025年5月24日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，由曾七次夺冠的阿伯丁对阵曾42次夺冠、且为卫冕冠军的凯尔特人。阿伯丁在点球大战中以4比3获胜；此前双方各自踢进一粒乌龙球。阿伯丁因此赢得自2013—14赛季苏格兰联赛杯以来的首个重要赛事冠军，也是自1989—90赛季以来的首座苏格兰杯。

en.s: The 2025 AFC Women's Champions League final was the final match of the 2024–25 AFC Women's Champions League, the 5th season of Asia's premier club women's football tournament organised by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC), and the first since it was rebranded as the AFC Women's Champions League. It was played on 24 May 2025 in Wuhan. between local club Wuhan Jiangda (Chinese Women's Super League champions) and Australian side Melbourne City (A-League Women premiers), both of whom reached a continental final for the first time.

zh.t: 2025年亚足联女子冠军联赛决赛
zh.s: 2025年亚足联女子冠军联赛决赛是2024—25赛季亚足联女子冠军联赛的决赛，这是亚洲顶级女子俱乐部足球赛事第5个赛季，也是赛事更名为亚足联女子冠军联赛后的首个赛季。比赛于2025年5月24日在武汉举行，由本地球队武汉江大（中国女子足球超级联赛冠军）对阵澳大利亚球队墨尔本城（澳大利亚女子联赛常规赛冠军）。两队都是首次闯入洲际赛事决赛。

en.s: The 2025 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2024–25 DFB-Pokal, the 82nd season of the annual German football cup competition. The match was played on 24 May 2025 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. The match featured Arminia Bielefeld, a 3. Liga side, and VfB Stuttgart, a Bundesliga side. Arminia Bielefeld, in their first final, became the fourth third-division side to reach the DFB-Pokal final.

zh.s: 2025年德国杯决赛决出了2024—25赛季德国杯冠军，这是该项年度足球杯赛的第82届。比赛于2025年5月24日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行，对阵双方是德丙球队比勒费尔德和德甲球队斯图加特。比勒费尔德首次闯入德国杯决赛，成为第四支闯入决赛的第三级别联赛球队。

en.s: The 2025 UEFA Women's Champions League final was the final match of the 2024–25 UEFA Women's Champions League, the 24th season of Europe's premier women's club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 16th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Women's Cup to the UEFA Women's Champions League. The match was played at the Estádio José Alvalade in Lisbon, Portugal, on 24 May 2025, between English club Arsenal and Spanish club and title holders Barcelona.

zh.s: 2025年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是2024—25赛季欧洲女子冠军联赛的决赛，为欧洲顶级女子俱乐部足球赛事第24个赛季、赛事从欧洲女子联盟杯更名为欧洲女子冠军联赛后的第16个赛季的收官战。比赛于2025年5月24日在葡萄牙里斯本若泽·阿尔瓦拉德球场举行，由英格兰阿森纳对阵卫冕冠军、西班牙巴塞罗那。

en.s: The 2025 Thai FA Cup final was the culmination of the 2024–25 Thai FA Cup, the 31st season of Thailand's premier domestic knockout football competition. The final was played on 24 May 2025 at Thammasat Stadium in Pathum Thani, Thailand. It featured a high-stakes clash between Muangthong United and Buriram United, two of the most prominent clubs in the Thai League 1.

zh.s: 2025年泰国足协杯决赛是2024—25赛季泰国足协杯的收官战，也是泰国顶级国内淘汰制足球赛事的第31个赛季。比赛于2025年5月24日在泰国巴吞他尼府的法政大学体育场举行，由蒙通联对阵武里南联。两队都是泰超最受瞩目的球队之一，这场对决备受关注。

en.s: The 2025 Coupe de France final was a football match between Paris Saint-Germain and Reims that decided the winner of the 2024–25 Coupe de France, the 108th season of the Coupe de France. The match was played on 24 May 2025 at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis. Paris Saint-Germain won the match 3–0 for their record-extending 16th Coupe de France title.

zh.s: 2025年法国杯决赛由巴黎圣日耳曼对阵兰斯，决出2024—25赛季法国杯冠军，也是法国杯第108个赛季的决赛。比赛于2025年5月24日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼以3比0获胜，刷新纪录，第16次夺得法国杯。

en.s: The 2025 European Rugby Champions Cup final was the final match of the 2024–25 European Rugby Champions Cup campaign, and the 30th European club rugby final in general. It was contested by Bordeaux Bègles and Northampton Saints on 24 May 2025. The Millennium Stadium was the host venue, the sixth time the European final has been at the stadium, matching Twickenham Stadium's record of six finals.

zh.s: 2025年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2024—25赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球第30届总决赛。对阵双方是波尔多贝格勒和北安普顿圣徒，于2025年5月24日交手。加的夫千禧球场是比赛场地；此前欧洲决赛曾六次在该球场举行，与特威克纳姆球场的纪录持平。

en.s: The 2025 Tasmanian Legislative Council periodic election was held on 24 May 2025 to elect three members of the Tasmanian Legislative Council. The seats of Montgomery, Nelson and Pembroke were up for election. The Liberal Party's loss to an independent candidate in Montgomery means independents now hold the majority in the historically non-partisan chamber. The elections were initially scheduled to be held on 3 May 2025.

zh.t: 2025年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 2025年5月24日举行塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举，改选3名议员。蒙哥马利、纳尔逊和彭布罗克选区的席位进行改选。自由党在蒙哥马利选区败给无党派候选人后，无党派议员成为该传统上不分党派的议会中的多数。选举原定于2025年5月3日举行。

en.s: The 2025 CONCACAF W Champions Cup final was the final match of the 2024–25 CONCACAF W Champions Cup, the 1st season of North America, Central America, and the Caribbean's premier club association football tournament organized by CONCACAF. It was played on 24 May 2025. The winner, Gotham FC, qualified as a result for both the 2026 FIFA Women's Champions Cup and the 2028 FIFA Women's Club World Cup.

zh.t: 2025年中北美洲及加勒比海足联女子冠军杯决赛
zh.s: 2025年中北美洲及加勒比海足联女子冠军杯决赛是2024—25赛季该赛事的决赛，也是中北美洲及加勒比海足球协会（CONCACAF）主办的北美洲、中美洲和加勒比地区顶级俱乐部足球赛事首个赛季的收官战。比赛于2025年5月24日举行。冠军哥谭足球俱乐部因此获得2026年国际足联女子冠军杯和2028年国际足联女子俱乐部世界杯的参赛资格。

en.s: The 78th annual Cannes Film Festival took place from 13 to 24 May 2025. French actress Juliette Binoche served as jury president for the main competition. Iranian filmmaker Jafar Panahi won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the thriller film It Was Just an Accident.

en.s: On 24 May 2026, a vehicle-borne suicide bombing targeted a shuttle train near Chaman Phatak in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan. The explosion killed at least 47 people and injured 98 others. The train was carrying Pakistani security personnel and their family members from Quetta's cantonment area to connect with the Jaffar Express. The Balochistan Liberation Army claimed responsibility for the attack.

zh.s: 2026年5月24日，巴基斯坦俾路支省奎达市恰曼法塔克附近，一列接驳列车遭遇汽车自杀式爆炸袭击。爆炸至少造成47人死亡、98人受伤。列车载有从奎达军营区出发、准备换乘贾法尔快车的巴基斯坦安全人员及其家属。俾路支解放军宣称对此次袭击负责。
